articles.title: Don't Drop the BATON: Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Agentic Subtask Exploration and Transition-aware Memory
articles.content: Long-horizon robot manipulation chains many contact-rich skills into one multi-stage task. Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly master the individual skills, yet the chain still fails: errors compound beyond the policy's ability to correct, and one subtask silently constrains the next. A promising recipe freezes the VLA and puts an LLM agent in charge: it plans in language, moves in free space with analytic primitives, invokes the VLA only for contact-rich segments, and writes adaptation into language memory. Applied to long horizons, it breaks twice. (1) Competence comes from whole-task exploration at test time, whose cost is multiplicative in stages: if one stage needs T episodes, a K-stage task needs about T^K, and a failure does not reveal which stage caused it. (2) It has no representation of transitions: the VLA primitive carries an exit but no entry condition, so a subtask can succeed in a form its successor cannot use. We present BATON. Against (1), BATON makes the subtask the unit of exploration: each is explored in the cheap short-horizon regime and its solution stored in memory; a long-horizon trajectory is then composed from these solutions rather than discovered whole. Cost becomes additive (T*K) and every failure is attributed to a single stage. Against (2), BATON equips exploration with a transition-aware memory. Within a subtask, a verifier agent governs the invocation transition: the VLA is called only after the wrist view confirms the scene is ready. Across subtasks, a handoff transition restores an entry state disturbed by the predecessor's residue, and a lookahead transition selects the strategy whose outcome the successor can inherit. No parameters are updated. On the long-horizon benchmark RoboMemArena, BATON improves task success by 11.6% and cumulative success by 14.9% over the SoTA.

articles.title_zh: 别掉BATON:通过代理子任务探索和过渡意识记忆进行长视机器人操纵
articles.content_zh: 长视机器人操纵将许多接触丰富的技能连锁起来,成为一个多阶段的任务. 视觉语言-动作(VLA)模型越来越掌握个人技能,然而链条仍然失败:错误复合到超出政策纠正能力,一个子任务无声地约束下一个. 一个很有希望的食谱冻结了VLA,并让一个LLM代理负责:它用语言进行规划,用分析原始物在自由空间中移动,只为接触丰富的部分引用VLA,并将适应写入语言记忆. 应用到长的地平线上,会断裂两次. (1)能力来自测试时的全任务探索,其成本是分阶段的倍增:如果一个阶段需要T事件,K阶段的任务需要T^K,失败不能揭示造成该阶段的哪个阶段. (2)它没有过渡的表示:VLA原始携带一个退出但没有进入条件,因此子任务可以以继承人无法使用的形式成功. 我们介绍巴顿。 反之(1),BATON使子任务成为探索的单位:每个子任务都是在廉价的短视系统中探索的,其解决方案存储在记忆中;然后从这些解决方案中组成长视距轨迹而不是发现整体. 成本变为添加剂(T*K),每一次失败都归于一个阶段. 反对(2),BATON为探索配备了过渡感记忆. 在子任务中,由核查人代理来规范引用过渡:只有在手腕视图确认现场准备就绪后才能调用VLA. 在整个子任务中,一个交接的过渡会恢复一个被前人残留干扰的进入状态,一个望头过渡会选择其结果可以继承的战略. 没有更新参数 。 在长距离基准Robo MemArena上,BATON比SOTA任务成功率提高了11.6%,累计成功率为14.9%。

articles.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
articles.content: This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.

articles.title_zh: 关于培训像素空间文本到图像传播模型的经验研究
articles.content_zh: 本文调查了基因建模中一个日益重要的话题:像素-空间扩散模型. 虽然对此专题进行了许多研究,但大多数研究侧重于小规模或类条件环境。 因此,仍然难以找到一种实用的办法来培训与既定的潜在空间对应方竞争或超过的像素空间模型。 通过全面的实证研究,我们首先观察到,像素空间中直接的大规模前期训练会比潜伏空间的汇合要慢得多。 这种观察激发了一种潜在到像素策略,在潜在空间中高效地获得基因前缀,并在训练后向像素空间过渡. 然后,我们系统地调查关于这一过渡的关键设计选择,包括重量初始化、数据组成、预测目标、解码器结构和噪音时间表,并找出一种实用的配方,使由此产生的像素-空间模型在提供3.18至4.75倍的端到端推论速度的同时,匹配或超过其潜在的空间模型。 我们希望我们的调查结果能为今后对像素-空间生成的研究提供有益的实证见解和实用指南.

articles.title: SplatGuide: Geometric Priors from 3D Gaussians for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
articles.content: Generating photorealistic novel views from unposed images requires both 3D geometric understanding and the ability to synthesize unseen content. A natural strategy combines feed-forward 3DGS reconstruction with multi-view diffusion. Yet prior pipelines extract at most one signal from the reconstruction, either pixel rendering or learned features, while none exploits per-Gaussian visibility for occlusion-aware reference selection. This *information disconnect* leaves renderable geometry, visibility cues, and learned features unused. SplatGuide closes this disconnect by reusing a single 3DGS scene across three complementary roles. Rendered images provide pixel-aligned geometric conditioning. Per-Gaussian source-view indices are rendered into a target-view voting map for occlusion-aware reference selection. Reconstruction tokens supply feature-level guidance via cross-attention. All three signals derive from the same reconstruction forward pass. Across RealEstate10K, DL3DV, Tanks-and-Temples, and Mip-NeRF 360, SplatGuide achieves state-of-the-art pose-free novel view synthesis. On RealEstate10K, with a moderate number of input views, it surpasses the ground-truth-pose baseline.

articles.title_zh: SplateGuide: 3D Gaussians 的几何前传用于 Pose- Free 小说视图合成
articles.content_zh: 从未放置的图像中生成光现实主义的新观点,既需要3D几何理解,也需要合成未见内容的能力. 自然策略结合了feed-forward 3DGS重建与多景传播. 然而,先前的管道最多从重建中提取一个信号,即像素渲染或学到的特征,而没有任何一个管道利用每个古西人的能见度来选择闭塞-知觉参考物. *信息断开* 使可变几何、能见度提示和学到的特性未被使用。 SplateGuide通过在三个互补角色之间重用单个3DGS场景来关闭这种断开. 渲染的图像提供了像素相配的几何条件. Per-Gausian的源视图指数被制成目标视图投票图,用于选择隐含-意识参考. 重建信使通过交叉注意提供特征级指导。 这三个信号都来自同样的重建前传. 横跨RealEstate10K,DL3DV,Tanks-and-Templles,和Mip-NERF 360,SplateGuide实现最先进的无假面小说观赏合成. 在RealEstate10K上,有适度的输入视图,超过了地面真实的基线.

articles.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
articles.content: A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

articles.title_zh: HarnessEval-W:认可对视觉世界的评价
articles.content_zh: 一个基准应提供比标分更高的分数:使评价值得信赖的是证明该分数合理的理由。 这对世界模型尤其重要,在其中,判断推出需要了解物理、因果关系和世界状态是否正确演变。 人类自然而然地发现这种侵权行为,然而,没有现有的基准使这种能力自动化:衡量标准是残酷的,没有能够检查或核实的推理链。 我们引入了HarnessEval-W,这是一个具有特效的评价管道,将LLM生态系统的利用范式引入世界模型基准。 HarnessEval-W不应用固定的标点,而是解释每个评价案例的背景,将评价问题分解为可测量的子问题,并产出专门的子代理,每个子代理都配备了量身定制的上下文和诊断工具来解释自己的子问题. 父母代理人随后确认所收集的证据,并将其归纳为最终判决。 这种分级的工作流程将每一项评价变成一个透明的证据树,其完整的推理链证明结果是合理的。 我们把HarnessEval-W应用于18个有代表性的世界模式,超过330个评价案例。 它的判断与人类的偏好密切吻合,同时对每次推出都提供了可核查的、精细的诊断。 我们开放整个管道作为现场基准,并邀请广大社区在世界模式不断演变时,为增加新的技能和评价案例作出贡献。

articles.title: Can Unsupervised Methods Outperform Supervised Deep Learning When Ground Truth Is Sparse? A Case Study of Bronchovascular Bundle Segmentation in Low-Dose CT
articles.content:
Background
  Lung cancer remains the deadliest cancer worldwide because it is often diagnosed too late. Effective treatment depends on detection at an early screening stage. However, the growing number of patients and the limited number of radiologists lead to prolonged diagnostic waiting times. In very early stage lung cancer, nodule visibility is further reduced by adjacent blood vessels and airway walls, because nodules are often connected to or supplied by these structures. Task-specific analysis of the bronchovascular bundle is therefore important for efficient nodule detection, and its removal can increase the diagnostic potential of lung cancer screening.
  Materials and Methods
  To assess the efficacy of the proposed method, we used series from widely utilized LDCT datasets, including the Duke Lung Cancer Screening (DLCS) dataset and the Pilot Pomeranian Lung Cancer Screening Program. The proposed bronchovascular bundle segmentation pipeline, RONALD, operates on computed tomography images and returns binary masks of vessels and bronchi located in the lung parenchyma. The method includes a preprocessing stage with lung, lobe, and mediastinum segmentation, followed by separate vessel and bronchial tree segmentation.
  Results
  The proposed pipeline segmented the bronchovascular bundle in low-dose computed tomography scans while improving nodule retention compared with other segmentation methods: from 93.98% and 90.36% to 100% in DLCS, and from 83.16% and 62.36% to 99.92% in the Pomeranian dataset.
  Conclusion
  The resulting segmentations can improve lung nodule detection in the very early stages of lung cancer.

articles.title_zh: 可不受监督 当地面真理是斯帕塞时, 超额执行监督深层学习的方法? 低剂量CT中铜血管包片分解的案例研究
articles.content_zh:
背景情况
肺癌仍然是全世界最致命的癌症,因为它往往被诊断为太迟。 有效治疗取决于在早期筛查阶段的检测。 然而,患者人数不断增加,放射科医生人数有限,导致诊断等待时间延长. 在很早期的肺癌中,结核的可见度由于邻近的血管和气道壁而进一步降低,因为结核往往与这些结构相连或由这些结构提供。 因此,针对具体任务分析支气管包对有效检测结核十分重要,除去支气管可增加肺癌筛查的诊断潜力。
材料和方法
为了评估拟议方法的功效,我们使用广泛使用的最不发达国家数据集系列,包括杜克肺癌筛查数据集和试点波美拉尼亚肺癌筛查方案。 拟议的支气管血管捆绑分解管道——RONALD——以计算成像图象和返回位于肺部的血管和支气管的二进制口罩运作。 这种方法包括肺,叶,中子分化的预处理阶段,然后是分离的容器和支气管树分化.
结果
拟议的管道在低剂量计算成像扫描中分解了铜血管包,同时与其他分解方法相比,结核保留率有所改进:DLCS从93.98%和90.36%至100%,Pomeranian数据集从83.16%和62.36%至99.92%。
结论
由此产生的分解可以改善肺癌早期的肺结核检测.

articles.title: Unlocking the Potential of Image Editing via Concept Scaling and Dense Supervision
articles.content: Existing image editing frameworks predominantly follow the training paradigm of text-to-image diffusion models. However, extending this paradigm to image editing highlights two inherent discrepancies, specifically, the insufficient attention to edit concept granularity and the training inefficiency caused by sparse supervision signals. To address these issues, we establish a comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy featuring over 1,000 fine-grained edit concepts and build ConceptEdit-12M, a massive dataset of 12 million high-quality editing pairs via an improved synthesis framework. This library-driven approach effectively rectifies the distribution collapse of generated data while ensuring high data fidelity. Furthermore, we propose a dense supervision training strategy that synthesizes multiple non-interfering concepts into single image pairs. By providing richer learning signals, this strategy significantly enhances both training efficiency and overall model performance. Training results validate our strategy, significantly outperforming prior works. Finally, we present ConceptEdit-Bench, a granular evaluation suite designed to diagnose model capabilities across a vast array of real-world scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 通过概念放大和强化监督来释放图像编辑的潜力
articles.content_zh: 现有的图像编辑框架主要遵循文本到图像传播模式的培训模式。 然而,将这种范式推广到图像编辑中凸显出两个固有的差异,具体来说,对编辑概念颗粒性重视不够,以及监管信号稀少导致培训效率低下. 为了解决这些问题,我们建立了一个全面的分级分类系统,其中包含1,000多个精细的编辑概念,并通过改进的合成框架构建了1,200万个高质量的编辑对的庞大数据集ConceptEdit-12M。 这种图书馆驱动的方法有效地纠正了生成数据的分布崩溃,同时确保高数据可靠性。 此外,我们提出了一个密集的监督培训战略,将多种非干涉概念合成单一图像对。 这项战略通过提供更丰富的学习信号,大大提高了培训效率和总体模式性能。 培训结果证实了我们的战略,大大超过以前的工作。 最后,我们介绍了概念编辑-奔驰(ConceptEdit-Bench),这是一个颗粒式评价套件,旨在诊断各种现实世界情景中的模型能力。

articles.title: Unsupervised Learning of Cell Instances with Generative Routing Pyramids
articles.content: Identifying and representing object instances such as cells or nuclei is a common task in microscopy image analysis. Established machine learning workflows typically use supervised detection or segmentation followed by feature extraction or classification, which requires manual annotations and treats instance segmentation and cell representation as separate stages. We describe a new unsupervised method for cell instance segmentation and phenotypic classification from unlabeled microscopy images. Our method is based on reconstructing each image using a coarse-to-fine routing pyramid that associates pixels with spatially sparse latent sources. The resulting pixel-to-latent associations yield instance masks, while the source latents encode cell morphology. We demonstrate competitive performance in instance segmentation across diverse cell morphologies and imaging modalities, as well as generative modeling of cellular phenotypes under perturbations. Source code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids.

articles.title_zh: 无监督地学习带基因线程的细胞实例
articles.content_zh: 识别并代表细胞或核等对象实例是显微镜图像分析中的一项常见任务. 已建立的机器学习工作流程通常采用有监督的检测或分解,然后是特征提取或分解,这需要人工说明,并将实例分解和细胞代表作为单独的阶段. 我们描述了一种新的无监督方法,用于细胞实例分化和从无标签的显微镜图像中进行中性分类。 我们的方法是基于重建每个图像 使用粗糙到精细的路由金字塔 将像素与空间稀少的潜在来源联系起来 由此产生的像素到纬度的关联产生实例口罩,而来源潜入则编码出细胞形态. 我们展示了不同细胞形态和成像模式的分化以及扰动下细胞酚类的基因模型化方面的竞争性表现。 来源代码和检查站见https://github.com/weigertlab/routing-pyramids。

articles.title: Diagnosing Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.content: Large vision-language models can recognize the objects and attributes in a crowded scene yet assign an attribute to the wrong same-class instance. Generic visual-question-answering accuracy marks the response as wrong, while object-hallucination metrics may regard both the object and attribute as image-supported; neither reveals the transfer. This study formalizes this blind spot as Dense Same-Class Attribute Misbinding (DSCAM) and presents InstaBind-Lite, a controlled benchmark that makes it directly measurable. Its 524 images contain 529 curated groups of 3-6 same-class entities, 1773 boxed instances, ordered neighbors, distinguishable color-like attributes, and four complementary question levels, yielding 9580 deterministically evaluated questions. Unlike existing protocols, source-instance annotations separate unsupported generation and recognition failure from an attribute copied from another visible entity. Binding-specific metrics further quantify transfer frequency, adjacency, ordinal distance, and intervention effects. Across five open-source and two commercial/API models, the open-source systems average 19.84% Misbinding Rate and the API systems 7.55%; these errors are hidden by aggregate accuracy. Among identifiable transfers, 80.70% and 81.51%, respectively, originate from adjacent instances. Localization and instance-first interventions help selected models but are not universal remedies. InstaBind-Lite therefore turns previously undifferentiated wrong answers into source-identifiable failure categories and tests a reliability dimension that conventional benchmarks cannot determine: whether a model knows not only what is visible, but which instance owns each attribute.

articles.title_zh: 诊断大视野语言模型中的同级属性错误
articles.content_zh: 大型视觉语言模型可以在拥挤的场景中识别出对象和属性,却将属性分配给错误的同级实例. 通用的可视问题回答精度将响应标记为错误,而对象-吸光度量可能同时将对象和属性都视为图像所支持的;两者均不显示转移. 本研究将这个盲点正式确定为"同级属性错误约束(DSCAM)"(Dense Same-Class Attroduction Missibility (DSCAM)),并提出了InstaBind-Lite(英语:InstaBind-Lite),这是一个可以直接测量的可控基准. 它的524个图像包含由3-6个同级实体组成的529个被曲解的组,1773个箱型实例,订购邻居,可分辨的色彩等属性,以及四个互补的问题层次,产生9580个决定性的被评价的问题. 与现有的协议不同,源代码说明将不支持的生成和识别失败从另一个可见实体复制的属性中分离出. 约束性特定指标进一步量化了转移频率、相接性、正线距离和干预效应。 在5个开源模型和2个商业/API模型中,开源系统平均为19.84%的错装率和API系统为7.55%;这些错误通过总的准确性来隐藏. 在可确认的转移中,分别有80.70%和81.51%来自相邻的情况。 本地化和第一实例干预有助于选定模式,但不是普遍的补救办法。 InstaBind-Lite因此将之前没有区别的错误答案转化为源识别出故障类别,并测试了传统基准无法确定的可靠性维度:一个模型是否不仅知道可见的,而且拥有了每个属性的哪个实例.

articles.title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
articles.content: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model. Most recent methods adapt large pretrained text-to-image (T2I) latent diffusion models for their strong capacity and generative priors. However, the variational autoencoder (VAE) in latent T2I models may discard restoration-sensitive details, while the open-ended synthesis prior can introduce content-inconsistent artifacts. We present PixRestore, a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer (DiT) for UIR, where the diffusion backbone is trained entirely from scratch, without relying on T2I pretraining. PixRestore performs flow matching directly on patchified pixels, preserving fine-grained details while keeping the token sequence tractable. To adapt to different degradations, PixRestore learns to predict the reliability of layer features using LQ--HQ DINO feature similarity. Features from more reliable layers are fused as dense conditioning, while less reliable layers receive stronger HQ-feature supervision to encourage degradation removal. We train PixRestore on a large-scale corpus of diverse scenes and degradations, and further finetune it into a one-step generator using DINO-based adversarial objectives for efficient inference. Experiments on public benchmarks and real-world test sets show that, with only about 50M parameters and single-step inference, PixRestore achieves the best overall fidelity, perceptual quality, and robustness to degradations among competing UIR models while being far more efficient. Larger PixRestore variants can further boost performance, demonstrating the scalability of our pixel-space design. Code and the curated benchmark can be found at https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PixRestore: 通过像素分泌变换器实现统一图像还原
articles.content_zh: 统一图像还原(UIR)旨在用单一模型从具有不同降解性的低质量(LQ)图像中恢复出高质量的(HQ)内容. 最近的方法调整了经过预先训练的大型文本到图像(T2I)潜在扩散模型,以适应其强大的能力和基因前科。 然而,潜在的T2I模型中的可变自编码器(VAE)可能会丢弃对恢复敏感的细节,而前作的开放式合成可以引入内容不一致的文物. 我们介绍PixRestore,一种用于UIR的VAE-无像素-空间扩散变换器(DiT),其传播主干完全从零开始训练,而不依赖T2I预训. PixRestore直接在被补丁的像素上进行流相匹配,保留精细的纹理细节,同时保持符号序列可拉动. 为了适应不同的降解,PixRestore学习了利用LQ-HQ DINO特征相似性来预测地层特征的可靠性. 更可靠的地层的地物被作为密集的调节而接合,而不太可靠的地层则接受更强的总部地层监督来鼓励去除降解. 我们对PixRestore进行大规模不同场景和退化的培训,并利用基于DINO的对抗目标,进一步将它微调为单步生成器,以高效推论. 关于公共基准和现实世界测试集的实验表明,由于只有大约50M参数和单步推论,PixRestore在相互竞争的UIR模型之间实现了最佳的整体忠诚、感知质量和对退化的稳健性,同时效率要高得多。 更大的PixRestore变体可以进一步提高性能,展示出我们像素-空间设计的可扩展性. 在https://github.com/csslc/PixRestore上可以找到代码和被整理的基准.

articles.title: Steering the Flow: Inverting Face Recognition Models via Gradient-Guided Flow Matching
articles.content: Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) aim to reconstruct representative training samples of target identities from face recognition models, exposing critical security vulnerabilities. Existing methods typically rely on indirect guidance or highly stochastic guidance, making it difficult to stably optimize generation trajectories toward target facial images. In this paper, we propose Steering Flow Model Inversion (SFMI), a novel two-stage white-box model inversion method that reformulates inversion as a trajectory-steering task. Specifically, Step I, Learning a Generic Flow Matching Prior, pre-trains a generic unconditional Flow Matching model to encode the manifold of human faces as a robust prior. Step II, Attacking with Progressive Guidance Scheduler (PGS), injects time-dependent target-specific gradients during sampling. By backpropagating through the target model to obtain gradients from intermediate generated states, PGS progressively injects adaptive guidance signals into the vector field. This process effectively steers the current generative flow from random noise toward the high-density regions of the target class. Under an identity-disjoint cross-evaluation setting using the CelebA dataset, SFMI achieves an ACC of 0.9248, an FID of 22.61, and an LPIPS of 0.3874 on the ArcFace target. Extensive experiments on multiple target models demonstrate that SFMI achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance in attack success and visual fidelity under the evaluated white-box protocol.

articles.title_zh: 引导"流":通过"渐入"-"引导""流"相匹配"的倒相识别模式
articles.content_zh: 模型倒置攻击(MIAs)旨在从面相识别模型中重建目标身份的代表性培训样本,暴露出关键的安全弱点. 现有方法一般依靠间接取向或高度有条理取向,使得难以将生成轨迹稳定地优化到目标面相上. 在本文中,我们提出"引导流模型倒置"(SFMI),这是一种新颖的两相白盒模型倒置方法,将倒置重塑为轨迹探测任务. 具体来说,步骤一,学习通用流相匹配前作,预取一个通用无条件流相匹配模型,将人类面相的多相编码为强前作. 步骤二,用渐进制导调度器(PGS)进行攻击,在取样时会注入有时间依据的特定目标的梯度. 通过通过目标模型回传从中间生成状态得到梯度,PGS逐渐向向量域注入适应性引导信号. 这一过程有效地引导了当前从随机噪声到目标类高密度地段的基因流. 在使用 CelebA 数据集进行身份-不关联交叉评价的设定下,SFMI实现ACC为0.9248,FID为22.61,ArcFace目标为LPIPS为0.3874. 对多个目标模型的广泛实验表明,SFMI在被评价的白盒协议下,在攻击成功和视觉忠诚方面实现了有竞争力的先进性能.

articles.title: Revisiting Classifier-Free Guidance Methods in Latent Diffusion Models
articles.content: Inference-time quality-enhancement methods are an effective and widely adopted means of improving diffusion models without expensive retraining. We study a family of training-free techniques conceptually rooted in Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG), most of which were originally proposed on older U-Net diffusion models and validated using metrics that assess image quality in isolation, without accounting for compositional alignment or semantic correspondence between the generated image and its associated text prompt. We re-evaluate eight such methods on two open-weight rectified-flow transformers under a fixed per-model protocol and three compositional-alignment benchmarks. No method consistently improves on CFG across the measured criteria. APG obtains several nominal best scores, but the corresponding gains often remain within the estimated evaluation uncertainty. Attention-perturbation methods provide isolated gains on SD3.5 Medium and more frequent degradations on FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base, while CFG remains a competitive lower-cost baseline.

articles.title_zh: 修订无类别指南 晚期扩散模式的方法
articles.content_zh: 推论时间质量提高方法是一种有效且被广泛采用的手段,可以改进传播模式而无需昂贵的再培训. 我们研究一套在概念上扎根于Classier-Free Guideline(CFG)的无培训技术,这些技术大多最初是针对更古老的U-Net传播模型提出的,并使用孤立地评估图像质量的衡量标准进行验证,而没有考虑到生成的图像与相关文本的对应性或语义对应性。 我们根据固定的每个模型协议和三个组成调整基准,对两个开量级整流变压器重新评价了8个这种方法。 在所有衡量标准中,没有一种方法能够持续改进CFG。 APG获得数个名义上最好的分数,但相应的收益往往保持在估计的评价不确定性范围内. 注意力-扰动方法为SD3.5提供了中度和更频繁地降解FLUX.2 [克林]4B Base,而CFG仍然是具有竞争力的低成本基准.

articles.title: Calibration-Free Vehicle Speed Estimation: A Monocular Keypoint-Template Approach
articles.content: This paper proposes a calibration-free framework for reliably and effectively estimating vehicle speeds from monocular videos, without relying on roadway features, camera calibration, or roadway-feature-based reference objects. The proposed framework estimates vehicle speeds using a 36-keypoint vehicle template and a homography matrix updated at each frame. A YOLO-based keypoint detection module is trained on diverse datasets, and two estimation strategies are compared: keypoint-only tracking and warped optical flow with dense spatial aggregation. Speed is estimated by projecting displacements into metric space using the homography, with validation conducted on over 400 video clips from roadside and overhead datasets, covering speeds from 30 to 100 mph. The method achieves reliable speed estimation on the VS13 and BrnoCompSpeed datasets, with the warped optical flow method delivering MAEs of 15.0% and 9.7%, respectively, and 77.9% and 93.1% of estimates falling within +/-20% error. After applying a 10% trim to remove edge-of-frame outliers, performance improves to MAEs of 11.7% and 7.6%, with within-+/-20% accuracy increasing to 85.3% and 95.4%. This work addresses key limitations of existing vision-based approaches and enables low-cost and efficient speed enforcement using portable devices such as dashcams and smartphones, thereby supporting citizen-based enforcement programs for traffic safety.

articles.title_zh: 校准无轨车辆速度估计:单向键-模板方法
articles.content_zh: 本文件提出了一个无校正框架,以便可靠和有效地估计单相机视频的车辆速度,而无需依赖路由特征、相机校正或以路由地貌为基础的参考物体。 拟议框架使用36个关键点的车辆模板和每个车架上更新的车速表对车辆速度作出估计。 一个基于YOLO的键点检测模块接受了关于多种数据集的培训,并比较了两种估计策略:仅键点跟踪和有密集空间聚合的被扭曲的光学流. 速度的估计方法是,利用人行图将迁移情况投射到公尺空间,对路边和上层数据集的400多段录像片段进行验证,涵盖从30到100 mph的速度。 该方法实现了VS13和BrnoCompSpeed数据集的可靠速度估计,被扭曲的光学流法分别提供15.0%和9.7%的MAE,以及77.9%和93.1%的误差. 在采用10%的修剪来去除机身边缘外层后,性能提升到11.7%和7.6%的MAE,在+/-20%内精度提高到85.3%和95.4%. 这项工作解决了现有以愿景为基础的方法的关键局限性,并能够使用便携式设备,如光滑相机和智能手机,以低成本和高效率地执行速度,从而支持基于公民的交通安全执法方案。

articles.title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
articles.content: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench

articles.title_zh: TRACE-Bench:分解并诊断多参考图像生成
articles.content_zh: 尽管最近在多参考图像生成的统一多模式模式方面取得了进展,但现有基准仍然围绕着预先确定的任务类型(如"主体构成")来编排,这些类型不适合这种组合设置,导致覆盖面分散,复杂性失控,诊断价值很少. 认识到多种多参考任务共享一套共同的原子操作,我们采取注重能力的观点,正式确定四个操作符:Anchor (f$),Distentle (g$),应用 (oplus$)和Compose (C$)。 任何多引用的提示可以被作为这些运算符的构成公式来表示,其结构复杂性由运算符位数量化. 基于这一提法,我们构建了TRACE-Bench,由大约1,600个跨档数1-8的评价案例组成,这些案例由631个公式模板和大约4,000个涵盖各种艺术风格和现实世界主题的参考图像所建立。 公式结构直接驱动一个操作者-对齐的人均能力分数评价协议和一个递归失败本地化的诊断树分析. 对9个主要模型的评价揭示了整体评分中看不见的洞察力:主要瓶颈在于分解(美元)和属性约束(美元等值),而不是场景层面的构成(美元等值),即使是最佳模型在属性忠诚上也只得0.74分. 项目网页:https://amuseum-whr.github.io/Trace Bench

articles.title: Binarized High-Efficiency RAW Video Restoration and Beyond
articles.content: RAW video restoration is fundamental to high-quality low-level perception and serves as the basis for a wide range of downstream vision applications. While binary neural networks (BNNs) enable efficient lightweight deployment for image enhancement, their deficiencies in modeling temporal coherence and activation value distributions hinder their effectiveness when applied to video scenarios. In this paper, we propose BinRVR, a binarized RAW video restoration framework that reduces computation and parameters by approximately 96% while incurring only about 4% performance degradation. Specifically, we present a Binarized Information Interaction Module (BIIM) to jointly model spatial and temporal information in an efficient and unified manner. Moreover, we develop a Distribution-Aware Binarized Convolution (DAB-Conv) that leverages the statistics of full-precision activations to mitigate quantization errors. The proposed framework further supports multi-bit quantization, enabling flexible accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different hardware constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our BinRVR achieves competitive performance compared with state-of-the-art binarized methods on RAW video restoration tasks, including low-light enhancement, denoising, deblurring, and super-resolution. We further explore the potential of our method on downstream video applications, including object detection and monocular depth estimation.

articles.title_zh: 双效高效RAW视频修复及以后
articles.content_zh: RAW视频修复对于高质量的低水平感知至关重要,并成为了下游广泛的视觉应用的基础. 虽然二进制神经网络(BNNs)能够高效地进行轻量级部署来增强图像,但其在模拟时间一致性和活化值分布方面的缺陷在应用到视频情景时会阻碍其有效性. 在本文中,我们提出BinRVR, 一个二进制的RAW视频恢复框架, 将计算和参数减少约96%, 而只发生约4%的性能退化。 具体地说,我们提出了一个二进制信息互动模块(BIIM),以高效和统一的方式联合模拟空间和时间信息。 此外,我们开发了一种分布-智能二进制聚合(DAB-Convolution),利用全精度活化的统计资料来缓解量化错误. 拟议框架还支持多位量化,使不同硬件制约之间能够灵活地进行精确效率取舍。 广泛的实验表明,我们的BinRVR在RAW视频修复任务上与最先进的二进制方法相比,取得了竞争性能,包括低光增强,去诺活化,去布鲁尔活化和超分辨率. 我们进一步探索我们的方法在下游视频应用方面的潜力,包括物体检测和单相深度估计.

articles.title: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
articles.content: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.

articles.title_zh: B. 不确定性之外:对收购退化下的外科分化的一般故障监测
articles.content_zh: 外科分解网络在获取降解下可能会无声地失败:即使模型信心仍然很高,预测的口罩也可能是错误的. 现有的部署时间监测员主要依靠不确定性估计,因此可能错过自信的失败。 我们提出TCSR-监控(TCSR-Monitor)(即时同位素外科风险监测),这是一个将信任与可观测形状、时间一致性和图像质量提示相结合的后期故障监测框架。 TCSR-Monitor包装了被冻结的分块模型,不需要模型内部,在部署时操作时没有地面真相. 我们还引入了一个验证协议,以评估在分配转移时警报是否仍然可信。 在2017年《远东公约》中, " 一一 " 腐败评估显示,TCSR-监测一般化为看不见的获取退化,并大大超过基于信任的基线。 循环控制证实它预测分解失败,而不是简单地检测被破坏的图像. Mondrian的校正平衡了整个退化断层的误差率,但单一的全球阈值仍然在中度腐败时对高达40%的正确分层框架产生虚假警报。 零射入SAM2显示特性可移植性,虽然在两个评价阈值上均超过了所传输的显示器。 总体而言,在收购退化下进行可靠的监测,不仅得益于可观测到的补充信号,而且不仅仅是信任,但仍然存在大量的虚假警报和转让限制。

articles.title: VicEdit: Learning to Edit Videos from Visual In-Context Examples
articles.content: Despite progress in instruction-based video editing, unimodal textual instructions inherently struggle to convey fine-grained textures and complex dynamics. To bridge this perceptual gap, we propose Visual In-context Editing, a new paradigm elevating video editing from textual instructions to multi-modal visual guidance encompassing single image, image pair, and video pair. To facilitate this paradigm, we curate VicEdit-400K, the first large-scale dataset for visual in-context video editing. We develop an automated pipeline to generate 400K high-quality samples across ten task types, ensuring superior visual fidelity and semantic consistency through multi-dimensional filtering. Leveraging this foundation, we introduce VicEdit, a unified framework to bridge visual and textual contexts. To adaptively extract editing semantics from heterogeneous references, we design Modality-Adaptive Semantic Distillation, which produces modality-specific semantic tokens from visual references. These tokens are then synergistically integrated with textual instructions through Dual-Context Injection, enabling the generation process to benefit from both visual and textual signals. Extensive evaluations on VicEditBench demonstrate that VicEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance across both basic instruction editing and visual in-context editing tasks, establishing visual in-context learning as a powerful and controllable paradigm for video editing.

articles.title_zh: VicEdit: 学习从视觉内文实例编辑视频
articles.content_zh: 尽管在基于教学的视频编辑方面取得了进展,但单模式文本指示在传递精细纹理和复杂动态方面存在固有的困难。 为了缩小这种观念差距,我们提议视窗内文字编辑,这是一种新的范式,将视频编辑从文字说明提升到包括单一图像、图像对和视频对在内的多模式视觉指导。 为了方便这个范式,我们管理了VicEdit-400K,这是第一个用于视觉内文本视频编辑的大规模数据集. 我们开发了一个自动化的管道,以生成跨越10个任务类型的400K高品质样品,通过多维过滤确保了更高的视觉忠诚度和语义一致性. 利用这个基础,我们引入了VicEdit,一个连接视觉和文字背景的统一框架. 为了适应地从各种参考文献中取出编辑语义,我们设计了Modality-Adaptive semantic Distillation,它从视觉参考文献中产生出特定模式的语义符号. 然后通过双Context Injection将这些符号与文字指令协同结合,使生成过程能够从视觉和文字信号两方面获益. 对VicEdit Bench的广泛评价表明,VicEdit在基本指令编辑和视觉内文编辑任务中都实现了最先进的性能,将视觉内文学习确立为视频编辑的强大而可控的范式.

articles.title: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for Image Dataset Quality Assurance in Multi-Center Breast MRI
articles.content:
Corrupted, inconsistent, or anomalous data silently threatens the safety and reliability of medical AI. Despite growing regulatory recognition of dataset quality assurance (QA) for high-risk medical AI, scalable automated detection remains underdeveloped. We employ unsupervised anomaly detection (AD) and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection as an automated dataset QA mechanism for multi-center dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI.
  We build a controlled AD benchmark of 17 realistic QA-relevant anomaly types from six public datasets (protocol violations, processing errors, incorrect anatomical regions) and propose a taxonomy of radiological image anomalies based on human visual perception, enabling fine-grained analysis of AD failure modes. The benchmark includes near-, medium-far-, far-OOD samples, as well as in-distribution and external normal data. Four methods are evaluated: a projection-based method extended with a domain-specific feature extractor and a novel positional encoding, a reconstruction-based approach extended to full 3D volumes with an augmented training objective, and two unmodified hybrid OOD detection methods.
  Medium-far- and far-OOD samples are detected reliably, whereas near-OOD samples and external normal data from unseen institutions expose method-specific differences. The 3D reconstruction-based approach best balances detection performance (AUROC: 0.936) and generalization to unseen institutions. The projection-based method with positional encoding achieves the highest overall detection performance (AUROC: 0.954). Both hybrid methods exhibit critical failure modes, confirming that methods validated for one modality or anatomy may not generalize without domain-specific adaptation. Implants and mastectomies remain an open challenge for all methods. Our results establish a foundation and practical guidance on scalable unsupervised QA in medical AI pipelines.

articles.title_zh: 多中心乳房磁共振中图像数据集质量保证的异常检测
articles.content_zh:
被腐蚀,不一致或异常的数据无声地威胁着医疗AI的安全性和可靠性. 尽管对高风险医疗AI的数据集质量保证(QA)的监管意识日益增强,但可扩展的自动检测仍然不发达. 我们采用无监督异常检测(AD)和分流外检测(OOD)作为多中心动态对比增强乳房核磁共振的自动数据集QA机制.
我们从6个公共数据集(protocol违规,处理错误,解剖错误区域)中构建出17个现实的QA相关异常类型的受控AD基准,并基于人类视觉感知提出放射性图像异常的分类法,对AD故障模式进行精细分析. 基准包括近地、中地、远地的样本,以及内部分布和外部正常数据。 评价了四种方法:一种以投影为基础的方法,并附有一个域特有特性提取器和一个新的位置编码;一种以重建为基础的方法,并扩展至完整的3D卷并附有一个增强的培训目标;两种未经修改的混合OOD检测方法。
可靠地检测出中远地和远地的样本,而近地取出样本和未见机构的外部正常数据则暴露出具体方法的差异。 基于3D的重建方法最能平衡检测绩效(AUROC: 0.936),并概括到看不见的机构. 以投影为主并有位置编码的方法实现了最高的整体探测性能(AUROC: 0.954. 两种混合方法都呈现出临界故障模式,确认对一种模式或解剖学验证的方法,若无特定域的调整,可能不会被概括. 植入和乳房切除仍然是所有方法的公开挑战。 我们的成果为医疗AI输油管中可伸缩而无监督的QA奠定了基础并提供了实用的指导.

articles.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
articles.content: The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

articles.title_zh: GenRouter: 代理图像生成的统一工作流程运行
articles.content_zh: 文本到图像(T2I)生成模型的快速演变有效地解决了原始像素合成的基础挑战,将社区的重点转向满足日益复杂的用户请求. 虽然最近的代理图像生成工作流程通过外部知识检索和迭代推理等先进能力来增强静态推论,但它们大多运行在有固定"一刀切"地貌的孤立地仓. 这不可避免地导致严重的计算-相配,简单的查询通过计算重的管道强制进行. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了GenRouter,这是第一个用于代理图像生成的统一工作流程路由框架. 我们首先制定GenCanvas,将各种代理管道标准化,形成一套通用的基础原始和可执行模板. 在统一空间上运行,GenRouter因地制宜地通过(一)需求剖析、(二)经验比对和(三)Pareto过滤,促使其进入最佳工作流程。 跨越不同基准的广泛实验表明,与重量级静电管相比,GenRouter实现了优异的视觉对接,同时将执行成本降低95%以上并降低65%。 此外,该系统通过积累的经验不断进行自我发展,从而能够强有力地进行零射一般化,提高性能,将计算间接费用减半。

articles.title: CytoFormer: A Molecularly Supervised Cell Foundation Model for Histopathology Cell Classification
articles.content: Identifying cell types directly from routine haematoxylin and eosin (H&E) histology would enable single-cell analysis at scale, but training such models has relied on manual pathologist annotations, which are slow, expensive and unreliable for many cell types. We instead supervise morphology with molecules. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics profiles individual cells in situ on a section that can afterwards be stained with H&E, so that molecular identity and morphology are observed for the same physical cell. We assembled 81 such paired Xenium sections spanning 16 organs, derived per-cell labels by clustering, marker-gene annotation, organ-wise human review and quality control, and mapped them onto the cell types commonly reported in each organ. This yielded 15.4 million cells, each with a paired H&E image patch and one of 23 cell types, on which we trained CytoFormer, a cell foundation model with a multi-task, per-organ classification head. On spatially held-out tissue CytoFormer reached an accuracy of 0.85 and a macro-F1 of 0.78 across all 16 organs, and its predictions reproduced the tissue architecture of an entire held-out section. The representation also transfers: with the encoder frozen, a linear head on CytoFormer features performed better than six pathology foundation models on four expert-annotated benchmarks, including on organs and cell types that were not part of pretraining. Finally, in an interactive active-learning setting, CytoFormer's embeddings are markedly more label-efficient than existing pathology foundation models, detecting normal epithelium amid look-alike tumour with an F1 of 0.82 from only a few annotations and leading the strongest baseline by 0.13 in F1. CytoFormer turns paired H&E and spatial transcriptomics into a reusable, label-efficient representation for cell-level analysis of routine histology.

articles.content_zh: 直接从常规血氧林和eosin(H&E)组织学中识别出细胞类型,可以进行规模的单细胞分析,但这类模型的培训依赖于人工病理学说明,对于许多细胞类型来说,这些说明很慢,费用昂贵,不可靠. 我们用分子来监督形态。 基于成像的空间转录相学在后可以被H&E所染色的区段上就地剖析出单个细胞,从而观测到同一物理细胞的分子特征和形态. 我们编组了81个这样的对齐的Xenium区段,覆盖了16个器官,通过集群、标记基因注释、器官人文审查和质量控制,得出每个细胞的标签,并将其映射到每个器官通常报告的细胞类型上。 这产生了1,540万个细胞,每个细胞有一个对齐的H&E图像补丁和23个细胞类型之一,我们在上面训练了CytoFormer,一个细胞基模型,有一个多任务,每个组织分类头. 在空间被抑制的组织上,CytoFormer在所有16个器官中达到0.85的精度和0.78的宏-F1,其预测重现了整个被抑制部分的组织结构. 说明还转移:由于编码器被冻结,CytoFormer特征上的线性头部在四个专家说明的基准上表现优于六个病理基础模型,包括未参加预训的器官和细胞类型。 最后,在一个互动的活性学习环境中,CytoFormer的嵌入比现有的病理基础模型明显更具有标签效率,从几个说明中检测出F1型0.82分的外观状肿瘤中正常的外观外观,并在F1中以0.13分领先最强基线. CytoFormer将配对的H&E和空间转录成可重复使用,标签效率高的表示,用于细胞层次对常规组织学的分析.

articles.title: PersonaShot: Benchmarking Person-Centric Narrative Continuity in Multi-Shot Video Generation
articles.content: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot clips to multi-shot narratives, where the human character serves as the core narrative anchor. However, existing benchmarks mainly assess character appearance or individual-shot quality, without measuring whether physical and emotional states remain coherent across cuts. They also rarely provide criterion-specific evaluation methods, although physical continuity, facial dynamics, and cinematic relations require different visual, temporal, and relational evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce PersonaShot, the first person-centric benchmark for narrative continuity in multi-shot video generation. PersonaShot contains approximately 1,000 multi-shot segments and 16 metrics spanning physical continuity, affective dynamics, and cinematic grammar. \textbf{\textit{1)} Narrative Continuity Benchmark:} We evaluate character coherence across three temporal levels: within-shot states, cross-shot transitions, and sequence-level trajectories. \textbf{\textit{2)} Human-Aligned Specialist Evaluators:} We distill reasoning from a large multimodal teacher into lightweight criterion-specific evaluators, each grounded in the visual, temporal, or relational evidence required by its metric, and align them with expert human judgments. \textbf{\textit{3)} Systematic Evaluation and Insights:} Our evaluation reveals distinct capability profiles across state-of-the-art models and a clear gap between perceptual quality and cross-shot narrative continuity. Even visually compelling videos frequently exhibit physical-state resets, abrupt affective shifts, and broken cinematic relations across shots. Human studies further demonstrate strong agreement between our evaluators and expert judgments.

articles.title: MIRROR: Multimodal Intelligent Radiology Reasoning and Observation Reporter
articles.content: A radiologist reading a model's output faces two problems. The model returns a number and no reason, and any system that turns that number into readable prose can quietly add claims the model never made. MIRROR is a research prototype built to separate those failures. It chains a multi-label classifier, a Grad-CAM localizer that turns each positive finding into a named anatomical region, and a report writer that receives the labels, probabilities, and regions but never the image. Because the language layer cannot see pixels, it cannot assert a finding the classifier did not make. We are precise about what that buys: a MIRROR report's findings are auditable against the probability vector, while the sentences framing them are ordinary generated text, and we show one stating a cardiothoracic ratio the system never measured. One registry holds the taxonomy, anatomy, and phrasing for chest X-ray, brain MRI, and head CT, so adding a modality is a data change; all three are routed and tested, one is trained. On ChestMNIST that classifier reaches macro AUROC 0.729 and ranks better than chance on all 14 labels, at 1.6 to 6.8 times the precision a random ranker would get. Yet at the default 0.5 threshold it emits no positive prediction at all for 11 of them, and its excellent-looking Brier score of 0.045 sits beside the 0.047 earned by a predictor that ignores the image. The discrimination is real; the decisions are not. Under the class imbalance normal in radiology, aggregate metrics flatter models that do nothing, and should be reported against that floor.

articles.title_zh: MIRROR: 多式智能放射学 理性与观察记者
articles.content_zh: 一个读取模型输出的放射学家面临着两个问题. 模型返回一个数字,没有任何理由,任何将这个数字变成可读道具的系统都可以悄悄地添加模型从未做过的声称. MIRROR是一个研究原型 用来分离这些失败 它将一个多标签分类器,一个Grad-CAM本地化器(Grad-CAM localizer),将每个正发现变成一个命名的解剖区,以及一个接受标签,概率,以及区域但绝不是图像的报告撰写器. 由于语言层无法看到像素,因此无法断言分类器没有做出一个发现. 我们很精确地知道这能买到什么:一个MIRROR报告的结果可以对照概率矢量进行审核,而设定它们的句子则是普通生成的文本,我们显示一个表示系统从未测量的心肌分率。 一个登记册持有分类学,解剖学,以及胸X射线,脑核磁共振,和头CT的用词,所以添加一种方式就是数据变化;这三种方法都经过了路由和测试,一个经过了训练. 在ChestMNIST上,分类器达到宏AUROC 0.729,并在所有14个标签上排名优于机会,精确度是随机分级器的1.6至6.8倍. 然而,在默认的0.5阈值下,它对于其中的11个却完全没有给出任何正面的预测,它优异的外表布赖尔得分0.045的比分就坐落在一个无视图像的预测器所获得的0.047的旁边. 歧视是真实的;决定不是。 在放射学正常的分级不平衡下,综合度量衡模型无所作为,应当对照该下限进行报告.

articles.title: AnchorScore: A CLIP-Based Diagnostic of MLLM Annotation Difficulty
articles.content:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are widely used for automated annotation, yet their per-class accuracy varies widely (e.g., 12%-98% across the 13 classes of three classroom sub-datasets) and is expensive to measure: evaluating one 27B MLLM on 5,416 validation images takes roughly 14 hours, whereas a frozen-CLIP pass over the same images completes in about 3 minutes. A low-cost signal for ranking classes by expected MLLM annotation difficulty a priori remains underexplored. Building on the AnchorProxy construct (per-class zero-shot CLIP accuracy) introduced in the companion study, this paper systematically evaluates its full-frame formulation, termed AnchorScore here, as an a priori diagnostic that flags the classes MLLMs are least likely to annotate reliably.
  On classroom behavior data (SCB5, 13 classes, 6 MLLMs), AnchorScore correlates with per-class MLLM accuracy (Spearman rho = 0.769, p = 0.002, n = 13). None of the alternative difficulty predictors (DINOv2, ResNet-50, SigLIP, or MLLM self-verbalized uncertainty) showed a significant class-level correlation at n = 13. A cross-model consensus control suggests AnchorScore primarily captures a shared class-difficulty factor rather than a CLIP-specific signal. An independent replication on Stanford40 Actions yields a nearly identical effect (rho = 0.817, p < 0.001); the association is strongest on activity-recognition data and attenuates on medical and satellite imagery.
  Three practical applications follow: a deployable hybrid CLIP/MLLM routing strategy (predicted-class routing: up to +23 pp over CLIP-only at roughly 44% MLLM cost savings), prompt disambiguation on hard classes (exploratory), and review-priority prediction for human verification. AnchorScore does not estimate exact MLLM accuracy; it provides a low-cost ranking signal that directs expensive MLLM evaluation to the classes where it is most informative.

articles.title_zh: 锁定分数:基于CLIP的 MLLM 诊断
articles.content_zh:
多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)被广泛用于自动化注解,但其每类精度相差很大(例如,在三个教室子数据集的13个类别中,12%-98%),而且测量费用昂贵:在5,416个验证图像上评价一个27B MLLLM大约需要14小时,而冷冻-CLIP在大约3分钟内通过同一图像完成. 按预期的 MLLM 注释难度排列的排序等级的低成本信号仍然未得到充分探讨。 本文基于伴生研究中引入的AnchorProxy构造(每等零射出CLIP精度),系统地评价了它的全帧配方,这里称为AnchorScore,是一种先验的诊断,它标出分类MLLM最不可能可靠地进行注释.
关于课堂行为数据(SCB5,13类,6个MLLM),AnchorScore与每级MLLM精度相关(Spearman rho = 0.769,p = 0.002,n = 13). 替代难度预测器(DINOv2,ResNet-50,SigLIP,或MLLM自言自语的不确定性)中没有一个在n=13时表现出了显著的类级关联. 一个跨模型的共识控制显示AnchorScore主要捕捉一个共享的类难因素,而不是CLIP特定信号. 对斯坦福40行动的独立复制产生几乎相同的效果(rho = 0.817,p < 0.001);协会在活动识别数据上最强,在医疗和卫星图像上最弱。
以下三种实际应用:可部署混合式CLIP/MLLM路由策略(预想类路由:最高为+23页,仅比CLIP高约44%的MLLM成本节省),对硬类(探索性)的迅速分化,以及人为核查的审查优先预测. AnchorScore并不估计准确的MLLM精度;它提供了一个低成本的排名信号,将昂贵的MLLM评价引导到信息最丰富的类别.

articles.title: Bridging the Gap between Labeled and Unlabeled Data via Unified Flow with Feature Memory Bank
articles.content: Although semi-supervised semantic segmentation ($\text{S}^4$) utilizes abundant unlabeled data to reduce manual labeling burdens, independent training of labeled and unlabeled data causes the former to dominate, which severely degrades pseudo-label quality. To address this challenges, we propose a novel remote sensing (RS) $\text{S}^4$ method via unified flow with feature memory bank (UFFM). Specifically, UFFM comprises two key innovations: unified flow (UF) and feature memory bank (FMB). The UF is a new training flow that generates less biased pseudo-labels by combining an external visual foundation model (VFM) with an RS domain teacher, and jointly optimizes labeled and pseudo-labeled data under a unified training objective. The FMB is a novel memory module for $\text{S}^4$ that dynamically updates class-specific features during training and reduces the feature discrepancy between labeled and unlabeled data through class-feature alignment. To verify the effectiveness of our model, we conduct extensive experiments on RS datasets. The experimental results show the superiority of our method over SOTA $\text{S}^4$ methods. Moreover, the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our contributions in bridging the optimization and feature representation gap between labeled and unlabeled data. Our code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}.

articles.title_zh: 利用特性内存库,通过统一流程来弥合标签数据与无标签数据之间的差距
articles.content_zh: 虽然半监督语义分解(\text{S}^4$)利用大量无标签数据来减轻人工标签负担,但对有标签和无标签数据的独立培训导致前者占主导地位,严重地降低了伪标签质量. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议采用新的遥感方法,即通过与地物记忆库(UFFM)的统一流动,提供$\text{S}^4$。 具体而言,UFFM包括两个关键创新:统一流(UF)和特征内存库(FMB). UF是一款新的训练流,通过将外视地基模型(VFM)与RS域名老师结合而生成较少偏颇的伪标签,并在统一训练目标下共同优化被标记和伪标签的数据. FMB是一款为$\text{S}^4$的新型内存模块,在训练期间能动态地更新类特有功能,并通过类特有功能对接来减少被标签和无标签数据之间的特征差异. 为了核实我们的模型的有效性,我们对RS数据集进行了广泛的实验. 实验结果显示我们的方法优于SOTA $\text{S}^4$的方法. 此外,这些结果表明,我们在弥合被贴上标签的数据与未贴上标签的数据之间的优化和代表性差距方面所作的贡献是有效的。 我们的代码发布在\href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RS-UFFM}。

articles.title: How Sampling Strategy Affects Imbalance Mitigation in LiDAR Segmentation: A Study of Structured vs. Random Point-Based Architectures
articles.content: Class imbalance in LiDAR point clouds poses challenges for semantic segmentation in autonomous navigation and urban mapping. While 2D vision has numerous mitigation techniques, their effectiveness in 3D remains unclear. We benchmark six reweighting schemes and five imbalance-aware losses across three datasets (DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D) using two architectures (KPConv, RandLA-Net). Inverse-frequency weighting degrades performance by up to 12% compared to uniform weighting, with catastrophic failures in minority classes. Uniform weighting performs within 2% of complex losses for structured sampling (KPConv) but benefits less for random sampling (RandLA-Net, up to 4.6% gap). Loss landscape analysis reveals a complex interplay: for structured sampling, imbalance ratio determines landscape geometry on real LiDAR data but decouples from it on synthetic data; for random sampling, landscapes show high sensitivity to dataset geometry regardless of imbalance ratio. For the two evaluated point-based architectures, these results suggest that the interaction between sampling strategy (structured vs. random), imbalance severity, and data acquisition characteristics shapes which mitigation approaches are effective.

articles.title_zh: 战略取样如何影响利达尔的平衡减缓 分块:结构与随机点结构的研究
articles.content_zh: 在LiDAR点云中的阶级不平衡给自主导航和城市测绘中的语义分化带来了挑战. 虽然2D愿景有许多减缓技术,但其在3D中的有效性仍不清楚。 我们使用两个架构(KPConv, RandLA-Net),在三个数据集(DALES, S3DIS, STPLS3D)中基准了六个再加权办法和五个对不平衡的认识损失。 相较于统一加权,反相频加权降低性能高达12%,少数阶层出现灾难性故障. 统一加权在结构化取样(KPConv)的复杂损失的2%内进行,但随机取样(RandLA-Net,差距可达4.6%)的效益较低。 失落地貌分析揭示出一种复杂的相互作用:对于结构化取样来说,不平衡比在真实的LiDAR数据上决定了地貌几何,但在合成数据上与它脱钩;对于随机取样来说,无论不平衡比如何,地貌对数据集几何高度敏感. 对于两个经评价的点结构,这些结果表明,抽样战略(结构化与随机性)、不平衡严重性和数据获取特征之间的相互作用是缓解办法行之有效的形状。

articles.title: Concept-based explanation of gene expression prediction from H&E images
articles.content: Recent advances in pathology foundation models have enabled accurate prediction of spatial transcriptomics (ST) from routine H&E images. However, existing explainability methods for vision transformer (ViT)-based models are largely limited to local heatmaps and do not reveal how morphological concepts contribute to ST predictions. Here, we introduce an explainable framework that combines relevance propagation and concept discovery to link transcriptional programs to tissue morphology. We developed a ViT-based framework for virtual ST from H&E images that combines ViT-aware layer-wise relevance propagation with relaxed archetypal TopK sparse autoencoder-based concept discovery. This approach provides both local explanations and global insights into the morphological patterns associated with transcriptional programs. We applied the framework to colorectal cancer ST data from the HEST-1k cohort and evaluated its generalizability in TCGA COAD. Our architecture accurately predicts clinically relevant ST signatures and accompanying molecular phenotypes. Measured and predicted gene expression profiles reveal substantial spatial heterogeneity of the colorectal cancer subtypes iCMS2 and iCMS3 across a large number of samples. Spatially resolved and aggregated iCMS classification achieve weighted F1 scores of 0.872 and 0.819 (0.770 in TCGA COAD), respectively, and both stratify patient outcome. Beyond prediction, our framework establishes a relevance-based concept atlas linking molecular phenotypes to histopathological representations. Comparison of activation- with relevance-derived concepts demonstrates that relevances provide a more direct link between tissue morphology and downstream predictions. We establish a general strategy for concept-based explanation of spatial prediction, and our framework is readily applicable to a broad range of ViT-based pathology models.

articles.title_zh: 基于概念的H&E图像对基因表达预测的解释
articles.content_zh: 最近病理学基础模型的进步,使得能够从常规的H&E图像中准确预测空间转录相学(ST). 然而,基于视变器(ViT)的模型的现有可解释性方法基本上仅限于局部热图,没有揭示形态学概念对ST预测的贡献. 在这里,我们引入了一个可解释的框架,将关联传播和概念发现结合起来,将抄录程序与组织形态学联系起来. 我们从H&E图像中为虚拟ST开发了一个基于ViT的框架,该框架结合了ViT-感知地层的关联性传播与宽松的拱门TopK稀有自编码器概念发现. 这种方法既提供了地方解释,也提供了全球对与抄录程序相关的形态规律的洞察. 我们把框架应用于HEST-1k组群的结肠癌ST数据,并在TCGA COAD中评估了它的通性. 我们的架构准确地预测了临床上相关的ST签名和相伴随的分子苯基. 经测量和预测的基因表达剖面显示,在大量样本中,直肠癌亚型iCMS2和iCMS3的空间差异很大。 空间解析和汇总的iCMS分类分别实现0.872和0.819的加权F1分(TCGA COAD为0.770分),同时对患者结果进行分级. 除了预测之外,我们的框架还建立了一个基于相关性的概念图集,将分子酚类与组织病理表达联系起来。 活化与关联衍生概念的比较表明,关联性在组织形态和下游预测之间提供了更直接的联系。 我们制定了基于概念的空间预测解释总体战略,我们的框架很容易适用于以ViT为基础的广泛的病理学模型。

articles.title: Turning spectra into images improves plant trait retrieval with 2D-CNNs
articles.content: Hyperspectral reflectance spectroscopy enables non-destructive estimation of plant functional traits, yet current deep learning approaches process spectra as one-dimensional sequences, which limits how they capture long-range inter-band dependencies. We asked whether transforming 1D spectra into 2D image representations improves multi-trait prediction with convolutional neural networks (CNN). We compared nine transformations using EfficientNet-B0 on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset (7,897 labeled spectra, eight traits, 400-2450 nm), benchmarked against published 1D CNN results on the same split. Trained from scratch, the simplest transformation, a direct Reshape of the spectrum into a 2D grid, performed best ($R^2 = 0.684 \pm 0.001$) and improved on the state-of-the-art 1D baseline ($R^2 = 0.587$, $+0.097$). We then pretrained a 2D masked autoencoder (MAE-2D) on 139,000 unlabeled spectral images. Linear probing, which freezes the encoder and trains only a multilayer perceptron head, reached $R^2 = 0.646$ and exceeded every 1D self-supervised counterpart, including the fine-tuned MAE-1D ($R^2 = 0.641$). Under cross-dataset evaluation all models lost most of their accuracy and none beat the 1D baseline significantly. To identify which wavelengths drive each prediction, we applied Integrated Gradients and Grad-CAM and unfolded band importance back to the spectral axis. Protein ($r = 0.45$) and leaf water ($r = 0.33$) agreed with sensitivities simulated by the PROSAIL radiative-transfer model, while carotenoids ($r = 0.06$) and leaf area index ($r = -0.11$) did not, showing that the model reads established leaf chemistry for traits with sharp absorption features. The representational advantage of 2D spectral images, rather than architectural complexity or ImageNet pretraining, drives the gain over 1D approaches.

articles.title_zh: 将光谱转换成图像可改善2D-CNNs的植物特性检索
articles.content_zh: 超光谱反射分光学可以无损地估计出植物的功能特征,然而目前的深度学习方法作为一维序列处理光谱,这限制了它们如何捕捉出长程段间依赖性. 我们问,将1D光谱转换成2D图像表示法是否用革命神经网络(CNN)改善多轨预测. 我们在GreenHyperSpectra数据集(7,897个被标注的光谱,8个特质,400-2450nm)上, 使用高效Net-B0对9个转换进行了比较, 从零开始训练,最简单的转变是将光谱直接重塑成2D网格,表现最好(R^2 = 0.684 = 0.001美元)并改进了最先进的1D基线(R^2 = 0.587美元,+0.097美元)。 然后,我们在139 000个无标签光谱图像上预先训练出一个2D口罩自编码器(MAE-2D)。 线性探测,能将编码器冻结并列车仅接通多层受器头,达到R^2 = 6.646美元,并超过每1D自控对接器,包括微调的MAE-1D(R^2 = 0.641美元). 在跨数据集评价下,所有模型都丧失了大部分的准确性,没有一种模型比1D基线大得多. 为了确定哪个波长能驱动每个预测,我们应用了集成梯度和梯度-CAM,并将波段重要性展开回光谱轴. 蛋白质(r = 0.45美元)和叶水(r = 0.33美元)与PROSAIL辐射-转移模型所模拟的敏感性一致,而卡通素(r = 0.06美元)和叶地指数(r = -0.11美元)则并非如此,表明模型读取了具有强烈吸收特征的既定叶子化学。 2D光谱图象的表示优势,而不是建筑复杂或ImageNet预训,推动收益超过1D方法.

articles.title: X$^2$Localizer: Cross-grained Alignment for Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization
articles.content: Cross-view Video Geo-localization (CVG) aims to localize ground-view videos by retrieving their corresponding geo-tagged aerial images. However, CVG approaches rely on fixed-length inputs and post-hoc refinement, hindering online-oriented localization under partial or dynamic observations. In this work, we formulate Progressive Cross-view Video Geo-localization (PCVG) as a deployment-oriented extension and evaluation protocol of CVG, enabling localization under varying temporal budgets, prefix-based inference, random-start evaluation, and long-range localization with interruptions. To explore PCVG, we introduce X$^2$Localizer, a cross-grained alignment framework that jointly supervises global prefix-to-aerial retrieval and token-aggregated frame--aerial-tile matching with a budget-dependent asymmetric objective. Furthermore, we introduce a Sliding-Window Re-Localization (SWRL) strategy that dynamically refreshes candidate regions for failure recovery and long-range deployment without full-sequence reprocessing. Extensive experiments show that X$^2$Localizer preserves conventional full-video performance, with marginal gains of +0.1 Recall@1 and +0.3 Recall@10, while substantially improving early localization. In the challenging single-frame setting, X$^2$Localizer improves coarse retrieval by +4.7 Recall@1 and +11.5 Recall@10 over the previous state-of-the-art method. With SWRL, our approach further enables robust progressive localization under random-start and long-distance scenarios, narrowing the gap between benchmark evaluation and real-world deployment.

articles.content_zh: 交叉取景视频地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地地 然而,CVG方法依赖于固定长度的输入和热后完善,阻碍了部分或动态观测下面向在线的本地化. 在这项工作中,我们制定了渐进式跨视图视频地缘定位(PCVG)作为CVG的部署取向扩展和评价协议,使得在不同的时间预算下能够本地化,基于前缀的推论,随机启动评价,以及有中断的远程地缘化. 为了探索PCVG,我们引入了X$^2$Localizer,这是一个跨纹相配框架,它联合监督全球前缀到空域取回和标语相配的帧-空域-平面相配,与预算依赖的不对称目标相配. 此外,我们推行了滑行-温道再本地化战略(SWRL),在不进行全序后处理的情况下,动态地更新候选区域的故障回收和远程部署。 广泛的实验表明,X$^2$本地化器保留了常规的全视频性能,边际收益为+0.1回想@1和+0.3回想@10,同时大幅度地改进了早期本地化. 在具有挑战性的单一框架设置中,X$^2$Localizer通过+4.7回想@1和+11.5回想@10改进了粗重回想,比起以前的最先进的方法. 与SWRL一起,我们的做法进一步使在随机启动和长途设想下能够强有力地逐步本地化,缩小基准评价与实际世界部署之间的差距。

articles.title: Training-Free Reconstruction-Based AI-Generated Image Detectors Are Inherently Vulnerable to Adversarial Examples
articles.content: The impressive visual quality and ubiquity of AI-generated images call for reliable and robust detection methods. Reconstruction-based detectors have emerged as a promising direction for transparent and training-free identification of synthetic images. However, due to their fundamentally different mode of operation (compared to standard, classifier-based methods), little is known about their adversarial robustness. In this work, we propose two novel attack methods targeted at detectors that leverage autoencoder reconstruction error. We find that by constructing imperceptible adversarial examples, the distance between original and reconstruction can be artificially increased, causing fake images to be wrongly classified as real. Our evaluation including images from three state-of-the-art generators and three detectors demonstrates that detection performance is significantly decreased, even if attacked images additionally undergo real-world degradations. Critically, our adversarial examples naturally transfer across detectors, as they all share the same principle, pointing towards an inherent vulnerability of reconstruction-based detectors.

articles.title_zh: 培训 -- -- 免费重建 -- -- AI-Geneed 图像探测器在固有意义上易受不良实例的影响
articles.content_zh: AI生成的图像令人印象深刻的视觉质量和无所不在,需要可靠而有力的检测方法. 基于重建的探测器已成为透明和无培训地识别合成图像的有希望的方向。 然而,由于它们的操作方式根本不同(与标准方法,分级方法相比),对其对抗力强性鲜为人知. 在这部作品中,我们提出了两种针对探测器的新式攻击方法,这些探测器利用自发编码器重建出错. 我们发现,通过构建难以察觉的对抗性例子,可以人为地增加原作与重建之间的距离,导致假图像被错误地归类为真实. 我们的评价包括从3个最先进的发电机和3个探测器得到的图像,显示探测性能显著下降,即使受到攻击的图像还受到现实世界的破坏。 关键的是,我们的对抗性例子自然地跨越了探测器,因为它们都具有同样的原则,表明基于重建的探测器固有的脆弱性。

articles.title: DRAFE: Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion of Heterogeneous Detection Transformers for Cross-City Fine-Grained Traffic Object Detection
articles.content: Deep learning-based object detectors are fundamental to intelligent transportation systems, enabling traffic monitoring, vehicle analytics, and infrastructure management. However, achieving both fine-grained vehicle recognition and robust cross-city domain generalization remains challenging. We present the Domain-Robust Asymmetric Fusion Ensemble (DRAFE), which combines independently trained LW-DETR and RF-DETR detectors for cross-city fine-grained traffic object detection. DRAFE employs a two-stage training strategy that first pretrains complementary detectors on diverse public traffic datasets using pseudo-label expansion and human-in-the-loop annotation refinement, producing a curated corpus of 6,049 images and 203,619 annotations, before challenge-compliant fine-tuning on the Project Hafnia Track 6 dataset. At inference, DRAFE applies anchor-conditioned class-consistent matching, reliability-weighted coordinate fusion, agreement-aware confidence recalibration, and complementary hypothesis recovery. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 6, DRAFE achieves 0.4022 mAP, ranks sixth among 25 participating teams, and improves by 0.0553 mAP over a preliminary ensemble evaluated under identical benchmark conditions.

articles.title_zh: DRAFE: 跨城市精细交通物件检测的异地探测变形器的域-罗布斯特不对称聚合
articles.content_zh: 基于深层学习的物体探测器对智能运输系统、交通监测、车辆分析和基础设施管理至关重要。 然而,实现精细的车辆识别和强有力的跨城市域通用仍然是个挑战。 我们介绍了Domain-Robust非对称融合集成器(DRAFE),该集成器结合了独立训练的LW-DETR和RF-DETR探测器,用于跨城市精细的交通物体探测. DRAFE采用两阶段培训战略,首先利用伪标签扩展和人行录注解改进,对各种公共交通数据集进行先行跟踪补充探测器,制作6 049个图像和203 619个说明,然后对哈夫尼亚轨道6号项目数据集进行符合挑战的微调。 推断出,DRAFE采用锚定条件的类相容匹配,可靠性加权坐标聚变,协议感信任再调整,并辅助假说恢复. 在AI城市挑战2026轨道6,DRAFE实现0.4022 mAP在25支参赛球队中排名第六,比在相同基准条件下评估的初步组合提高0.0553 mAP.

articles.title: HarmTrace: Anchor-Calibrated Decoupled Optimization for Fine-Grained Target Identification in Harmful Memes
articles.content: Multimodal harmful meme detection is typically formulated as image--text harmfulness classification. A model may correctly predict harmfulness while misidentifying the attacked target or its supporting evidence. We therefore extend harmful meme detection with fine-grained target identification, asking what type of target is attacked, who is targeted, and where the target appears in the meme. The model predicts harmfulness for every meme and, for harmful memes, outputs the target category, target entity, textual mention, and visual region. To support this task, we introduce Meme3W, which unifies multiple public harmful meme datasets and provides human-verified annotations for harmful instances. We further introduce Joint Record Accuracy (JRA), a strict record-level metric requiring the harmfulness label and all target-identification fields to be jointly correct. Experiments with representative multimodal large language models reveal a substantial gap between harmfulness accuracy and JRA. To narrow this gap, we propose HarmTrace, an anchor-calibrated decoupled optimization framework. HarmTrace strengthens target-entity supervision through entity-aware supervised fine-tuning. It then applies Conditional Target-identification Policy Optimization (CTPO) to decouple harmfulness and target-identification advantages, restricting target-identification optimization to label-correct responses for harmful examples. CTPO uses a Virtual Positive Anchor (VPA) as a fully correct reference for target-identification advantage normalization. HarmTrace improves both JRA and harmfulness accuracy across the evaluated backbones, with JRA on the Qwen3-VL-8B backbone increasing from 17.58\% to 52.51\%. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-Harmful-Memes.

articles.title_zh: 伤害追踪:在有害物质中优化精细目标识别
articles.content_zh: 典型的多式有害膜检测是成像-文字有害分类。 模型可能在错误识别被攻击目标或其佐证证据的同时正确预测有害性. 因此,我们用精细的标靶识别法来扩大有害的meme探测,询问被攻击的目标类型,目标是谁,目标出现在meme中的位置. 该模型预测了每个中度的危害性,对于有害中度,输出目标类别,目标实体,文字提及,以及视觉区域. 为了支持这项任务,我们引入了Meme3W,它统一了多个公共有害的Meme数据集,并为有害事件提供了经人验证的说明. 我们进一步采用了联合记录精确度(JRA),这是一个严格的记录水平的衡量标准,要求有害性标签和所有目标识别域共同纠正。 具有代表性的多式大型语言模型的实验表明,有害性准确度与JRA之间存在很大差距。 为了缩小这一差距,我们提出HarmTrace,一个锚定的解耦优化框架. 有害追踪通过实体意识监督的微调加强目标实体的监督。 然后,它将有条件的目标识别政策优化(CTPO)用于去除有害性和目标识别优势,将目标识别优化限制在有害实例的标签正确反应上. CTPO使用一个虚拟正锁定器(VPA)作为目标识别优势正常化的完全正确的参考. HarmTraces在被评价的骨干上提高了JRA和有害性的准确度,Qune3-VL-8B骨干上的JRA从17.58\%增加到 52.51\%. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/llly1234/HarmTrace-for-H有害-Memes上公开查阅。

articles.title: Beyond Accuracy: Assessing Calibration of Geospatial Foundation Models and Their Sensitivity to Distribution Shifts
articles.content: Geospatial Foundation Models (GeoFMs) are most commonly ranked and selected by accuracy on standard benchmark conditions via averaged ranks. We show that this protocol is too narrow: the promised deployment in critical EO tasks requires further angles of analysis, mainly calibration, the agreement between a model's confidence and its correctness. Across 16 frozen encoders, four classification and five segmentation datasets, and two orthogonal stress axes, every encoder degrades as corruption intensifies, and the ranking changes as well. Across the four classification benchmarks, EO-pretrained and ImageNet-pretrained encoders are indistinguishable on clean accuracy and clean calibration, and EO pretraining provides no more stability under shift than ImageNet pretraining. Under shift the GeoFMs drift further into overconfidence than the ImageNet-pretrained encoders, at every grade and in every corruption family. A centered kernel alignment (CKA) analysis ties this to representational rigidity: EO-pretrained embeddings move less under corruption while losing just as much task information and remaining overconfident. We apply three commonly explored uncertainty quantification methods and find that temperature scaling and deep ensembles cannot counteract the degradation, while a Gaussian-process probe roughly halves ECE under severe cloud only by tripling it on clean data. In selective prediction experiments, we find that confidence-based abstention cannot defer around confidently wrong predictions, and advocate that benchmark rankings and evaluations should therefore operate across a multitude of conditions and metrics to more holistically evaluate model development progress and close the gap to real world deployment scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 超越准确性:评估地理空间基础模型的校正及其对分配转变的敏感性
articles.content_zh: 地理空间基金会模型(GeoFMs)最常见的是按标准基准条件通过平均排名准确排序和选择. 我们显示,这项协议过于狭窄:在关键的道德操守办公室任务中承诺的部署需要更多的分析角度,主要是校正,一个模型的信心与其正确性之间的一致. 16个被冻结的编码器,4个分类和5个分解数据集,以及2个正交应力轴,每个编码器都随着腐败的加剧而退化,排名也发生了变化。 在所有四项分类基准中,EO预导和ImageNet预导编码器在清洁准确性和校正性上是无法区分的,EO预导训练在转换下比ImageNet预导训练更无稳定性. 在转变中,GeoFMs比ImageNet预先训练过的编码器,在每一个级别和每一个腐败家庭都进一步陷入了过度自信. 核心内核对接(CKA)分析将此与代表刚性联系起来: 道德操守办公室预先训练的嵌入装置在腐败下的行动较少,同时丢失同样多的任务信息并保持过度自信。 我们采用了三种共同探索的不确定性量化方法,发现温度缩放和深层共聚物无法抵消降解,而高斯-过程探测器在严重云层下将欧洲经委会大约减半,只能通过在清洁数据上增加三倍。 在有选择的预测实验中,我们发现基于信心的弃权不能绕过自信的错误预测,因此主张基准排名和评价应跨越多种条件和衡量标准,以便更全面地评价发展进度模型,并缩小差距,使之与现实世界部署情景相适应。

articles.title: Interactive Whole Slide Images for RL-based Tumour Segmentation
articles.content: Whole-slide image (WSI) analysis remains computationally challenging due to the extremely large spatial resolution of slides and the sparse distribution of tumour regions. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for sequential tumour segmentation directly on WSIs. Instead of treating the slide as a predefined collection of candidate patches, we formulate the WSI itself as a hierarchical multi-resolution environment through which an agent navigates using movement, zooming, and tumour selection actions. The agent jointly processes local observations and a global thumbnail representation within an actor-critic architecture trained using proximal policy optimization (PPO). Experiments on pulmonary adenocarcinoma WSIs demonstrate the feasibility of direct sequential tumour segmentation on full slides, achieving comparable coarse segmentation quality relative to patch-based approaches operating at similar magnification levels, while reducing inference time to a few seconds per slide. We further analyse the impact of environment design and action-space granularity. Our results suggest that modelling WSIs as interactive environments provides a promising direction for RL-based computational pathology

articles.title_zh: 基于 RL 的 Tumour 分片的交互式全幻灯片图像
articles.content_zh: 由于幻灯片的空间分辨率极高,肿瘤区域分布稀少,全滑图象分析在计算上仍然具有挑战性. 我们提出一个从端到端的强化学习框架,用于直接在WSIs上连续分出肿瘤. 我们不把幻灯片视为预定义的候选补丁集合,而是将WSI本身设定为一个分级多分辨率环境,通过该环境,物剂通过移动,缩放和肿瘤选择动作来导航. 代理人联合处理地方观察和全球缩略图,在一个通过近距离政策优化(PPO)培训的演员-批评架构内进行。 在肺干细胞瘤WSIs上进行的实验证明了在全滑上直接相继进行肿瘤分化的可行性,相对于在类似放大水平下运行的以补丁为基础的方法,实现了可比较的粗分化质量,同时将推论时间缩短到每滑行几秒. 我们进一步分析环境设计和行动空间颗粒性的影响。 我们的结果表明,将世界安全倡议建模为互动环境,为基于RL的计算病理学提供了一个有希望的方向。

articles.title: GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration
articles.content: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: GeoPose:通过投影-空间校正进行病人不可知CTA到DSA的注册
articles.content_zh: 将操作内双平面数字减取血管造影术(DSA)与程序前计算成的血管造影术(CTA)相协调,需要快速而准确的3D到2D注册. 以优化为基础的方法对初始化很敏感,可能需要上百次迭代,而以学习为基础的方法通常依赖于针对病人的培训。 我们提出GeoPose,这是一个经过人口训练的框架,通过投影空间校正和改变组成,在有学问的舟形框架中估计C-臂的外形,并将其转移到一个看不见的C-TA的内框上。 由人口培训的剩余网络完善了姿势,然后可选择低预算图像驱动优化。 GeoPose既不需要针对特定病人的适应,也不需要明确的体积间预先登记。 在20名被搁置患者的80个DSA观测中,无优化的GeoPose实现了心动平均预测中线距离(mPCD)为5.8毫米,ClDice为0.45分,而表现最好的基线为14.5毫米和0.28分,同时只需要0.15秒. 经过25次优化迭代后,GeoPose在约2秒内达到4.6毫米的mPCD和0.58的clDice. 在同一预算下,本土-初始化优化分别实现了14.6毫米和0.15毫米. 因此,GeoPose提供了快速的本土机身登记,并附有固定的人口级别加权数和下游双鱼3D血管重建所需的几何对应数。

articles.title: Towards Zero-Shot Domain Generalization for ID Cards Presentation Attack Detection
articles.content:
Presentation-Attack Detection (PAD) for national ID cards is limited by the lack of publicly available genuine samples, making it difficult for systems to generalize across countries. This paper introduces two main innovations: (1) a Prototypical Network head using an EfficientNet-V2-b0 backbone that requires only four genuine samples per class to create reliable prototypes; and (2) an episodic training regime that keeps PAD classes fixed while varying the card domain, allowing the network to learn universal attack cues.
  Evaluated on a large multi-country dataset and the public DLC-2021 benchmark, this method achieves an average Equal Error Rate of around 9\%, outperforming conventional softmax and CLIP zero-shot baselines even with data from a single source country. This approach provides accurate, privacy-preserving PAD while minimizing data collection, facilitating scalable cross-jurisdictional remote onboarding.

articles.title_zh: 实现身份证介绍的零热域通用化攻击检测
articles.content_zh:
由于缺乏可公开获取的真正样本,国家身份证的演示-跟踪检测受到限制,使得系统难以在各国通用。 本文引入了两大创新:(1)使用高效Net-V2-b0主干线的原型网络头部,每班只需要四个真样来创建可靠的原型;(2)在改变卡片域的同时保持PAD课程固定的中枢训练制度,使网络可以学习通用攻击提示.
在对大型多国数据集和公共DLC-2021基准进行评估后,这一方法实现了平均等误率在9-%左右,比常规软度和CLIP零射入基准差,即使有一个单一来源国的数据。 这种方法提供准确、保护隐私的PAD,同时尽量减少数据收集,便利可扩展的跨管辖区远程上船。

articles.title: Ultra: Unsupervised Cross-Task Optimization for Reliable Restoration Segmentation Collaboration under Adverse Weather
articles.content: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Adverse Weather Semantic Segmentation (UDA-ASS) aims to transfer semantic knowledge from labeled normal-weather images to unlabeled adverse environments. Existing approaches implicitly assume that restoration and segmentation provide mutually beneficial guidance. However, under severe degradation and without target-domain supervision, the validity of cross-task optimization directions becomes fundamentally unidentifiable, leading to hallucination-driven error propagation. In this work, we propose a novel Unsupervised Restoration-Segmentation Collaborative Learning Framework (Ultra), which reframes cross-task interaction as direction selection under uncertainty and causal effect estimation, enabling reliable collaboration through candidate direction generation and intervention-based filtering. In detail, we propose CTDN and CMIL. The former exploits complementary visual structures and semantic information to generate candidate optimization directions and performs cooperative direction selection between restoration and segmentation. The latter reformulates cross-task information transfer from correlation-based propagation into causal effect assessment, suppressing hallucination propagation. Extensive experiments on three widely used UDA-ASS benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art segmentation performance. Beyond segmentation, our framework achieves better unsupervised restoration results than existing UDA-ASS restoration methods and generalizes to unsupervised restoration and object detection collaboration tasks. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra.

articles.title_zh: 极地:在恶劣天气下,无监督的跨任务优化可靠恢复分裂协作
articles.content_zh: 无监督域适应不良天气语义分解(UDA-ASS)旨在将语义学知识从被标记为正态-天气图像转移到被标记为无标记的不利环境. 现有办法隐含地假定恢复和分化提供了互利的指导。 然而,在严重退化和没有目标领域监督的情况下,跨任务优化方向的有效性变得根本无法识别,导致由幻觉驱动的错误传播. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个新颖的无监督恢复-分区协作学习框架(Ultra),该框架将跨任务互动重新设定为在不确定和因果效应估计下的方向选择,通过候选方向生成和干预过滤,能够进行可靠的协作. 详细来说,我们提出CTDN和CMI. 前者利用互补的视觉结构和语义信息,生成候选人优化方向,并在恢复和分化之间执行合作方向选择. 后者将跨任务信息从基于相关性的传播转移到因果影响评估,抑制了幻觉传播。 对三个广泛使用的UDA-ASS基准进行的广泛实验显示了最先进的分解性能. 除了分解外,我们的框架比现有的UDA-ASS恢复方法更能取得不受监督的恢复结果,并概括为不受监督的恢复和物体检测协作任务. 守则和模型可在https://github.com/Wang-Shiqin/Ultra上查阅。

articles.title: SQuad: Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
articles.content: Video Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) spend most of their compute inside the Self-Attention operation, whose cost grows quadratically, $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$, with the number of latent tokens $n$. For the task of video generation, the token count is large, so this term dominates runtime and memory, and thereby caps the resolution and duration we can generate. Linear $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and low-rank $\mathcal{O}(nk)$ surrogates of Self-Attention trade the full softmax $QK^T$ for cheaper kernels, but rarely recover the original's expressivity, leaving a stubborn quality gap. Motivated by this, we propose SQuad, a Sub-Quadratic Attention Distillation framework that achieves a complexity of $\mathcal{O}(n\sqrt{n})$ in the resulting distilled Attention, naturally balancing the efficiency v/s expressivity trade-off. Instead of training our own Video DiT from scratch, which is prohibitively expensive, we fit a pretrained full softmax Self-Attention DiT into our proposed SQuad-Attention one by distilling the former in two stages: Flow-Matching Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), followed by improved Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD2) which additionally makes the sampling more efficient. On the Wan~2.2 5B text-to-video model, SQuAD matches the quadratic teacher on VBench ($83.20$ v/s $83.08$) while cutting the per-step per-block attention FLOPs by $\sim$$67\times$ and attention latency by $\sim$$11\times$, and end-to-end DiT latency by 2$\times$, all while also generating a video in only $6$ Neural Functional Evaluations (NFEs) instead of the default $100$.

articles.title: Supervising the Path to Fine Scales: GalerkinFlow for Scientific-Field and Image Super-Resolution
articles.content: Most super-resolution models learn from paired data by supervising only the final high-resolution output. This provides little control over how the prediction should evolve between the downsampled observation and its fine target. We introduce GalerkinFlow, an equation-agnostic framework that turns each coarse--fine pair into supervision along an entire reconstruction path. At a random sample of intermediate states on the reconstruction path, the model predicts the coarse-to-fine residual velocity and uses coarse-anchor point to define a pseudo-endpoint. We show that the reconstruction loss of this pseudo-endpoint is exactly related to the intermediate velocity loss through a known time-dependent weight. Consequently, every intermediate state contributes supervision toward the same fine target, rather than serving only as an internal step toward an endpoint loss. Because intermediate states already reveal part of the missing fine-scale structure, we additionally supervise the coarse endpoint used during one-step inference. A finite-difference objective further constrains local spatial variation. GalerkinFlow combines convolutional features with scale-conditioned Galerkin operator mixing and requires no governing equation or physical metadata. It achieves the lowest raw-space errors among the evaluated equation-agnostic baselines on Navier--Stokes and Darcy Flow, while remaining competitive on DIV2K.
