articles.title_zh: 监督精细缩放路径: Galerkin Flow 用于科学领域和图像超分辨率
articles.content_zh: 大多数超分辨率模型只通过监督最终的高分辨率输出来从配对数据中学习. 这几乎无法控制下取样观测与其精细目标之间的预测应如何演变。 我们介绍Gallerkin Flow, 一个方程式可知性框架, 将每个粗细的对子 变成整个重建道路上的监督。 在重建路径上的中间状态的随机抽样中,模型预测粗到细的剩余速度,并使用粗到分点来定义伪端点. 我们显示,这一伪端点的重建损失与中间速度损失完全通过已知的时间依赖权重而存在联系. 因此,每一个中间国家都为同样的精细目标提供监督,而不是仅仅作为内部步骤,走向终点损失。 因为中间状态已经揭示了部分缺失的细尺度结构,我们额外监督了在一步推论中使用的粗端点. 有限偏差目标进一步限制了当地的空间变化。 盖勒金 Flow结合了演化特征和标定条件的Gallerkin操作员混合,不需要管理方程式或物理元数据. 它在Navier-Stokes和Darcy Flow上实现了被评价的方程式不可知基线中的最低原始空间差错,同时在DIV2K上保持竞争力.

articles.title: Automatic Cephalometric Landmark Localization on CBCT-Derived Digitally Reconstructed Radiographs for Skeletal Malocclusion Classification
articles.content: Manual cephalometric landmark annotation is important for craniofacial assessment but is labor-intensive and difficult to scale. We introduce CephViT, a Vision Transformer-based model for automated 2D lateral cephalometric landmark localization, and evaluate its use in downstream skeletal malocclusion classification. CephViT was trained and benchmarked on a public lateral cephalogram dataset, achieving a mean radial error of 1.28 +/- 1.42 mm and a successful detection rate of 92.0% at 3.0 mm. Because the private evaluation cohort consisted of 3D CBCT scans, lateral cephalogram-like digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) were generated from each volume and used as 2D inputs to the landmark localization model. Landmark coordinates were normalized into a common coordinate frame, and skeletal malocclusion classification was performed using landmarks shared between the reference and DRR-based pipelines. Classification performance using DRR-localized landmarks was comparable to that obtained using manually annotated reference landmarks, with accuracies of 70.0% and 68.3%, respectively. These results support the feasibility of automated cephalometric analysis on CBCT-derived DRRs for skeletal malocclusion assessment.

articles.title_zh: 自动计程器 CBCT-Derived Digital Researched Radiographs for Skeletal Maloclation Classion 分类上的地标本地化
articles.content_zh: 人工脑力测量标志性说明对颅骨评估很重要,但劳力密集,难以推广。 我们引入了CephViT,一种基于Vision Transformer的模型,用于自动化的2D横向脑积分地标本地化,并评价它在下游骨骼分泌分类中的用途. CephViT接受过培训,并以一个公共的横向cephalogram数据集作为基准,实现了平均射线误差1.28 +/-1.42毫米,成功检测率为92.0%,3.0毫米. 由于私人评价组由3D CBCT扫描组成,因此从每卷生成类似cephalogram的数字重建射电图(DRR),并用作标志性本地化模型的2D输入. 地标坐标正常化为共同坐标框架,采用参考和基于减少灾害风险的管道共用的地标进行骨骼杂乱分类。 使用减少灾害风险本地化地标的分类业绩与使用人工附加说明的参考地标的分类业绩相似,分别为70.0%和68.3%。 这些结果支持对CBCT衍生的减少灾害风险进行自动脑力分析的可行性,以便进行骨骼麻痹评估。

articles.title: FLEET: Token-Based Feature Extraction for Event Camera-based Reinforcement Learning
articles.content: Event cameras generate asynchronous, high-frequency data streams offering spatially sparse information at lower latency than traditional cameras.In principle, these properties should be ideal for the design of control policies.However, reinforcement learning research in this field remains limited as existing approaches fail to fully exploit the sensor's properties.CNN-based methods negate the sensors benefits by aggregating events into sparse grids. This couples compute cost to sensor resolution and blurs the temporal information. Meanwhile, existing generative baselines rely on the availability of trajectory data to pretrain the model. We propose FLEET (Feature Learning from Events via Efficient Tokenization), a feature extractor that processes event sequences directly. Leveraging random Fourier features and cross-attention, our architecture compresses variable streams into fixed-size latent representations. This decouples inference cost of the feature extractor's backbone from the sensor's resolution, enabling end-to-end learning without auxiliary losses. We validate FLEET on a new, high-throughput benchmark. The results demonstrate that our sequence-based approach surpasses SOTA performance and exhibits superior robustness to variations in observation frequencies.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FLEET:基于托肯的特征提取用于事件相机强化学习
articles.content_zh: 事件摄像头产生同步的高频数据流,在比传统摄像头更低的空闲时间提供空间稀少的信息. 原则上,这些属性应当是设计控制政策的理想. 然而,这一领域的强化学习研究仍然有限,因为现有方法未能充分利用传感器的特性。 基于CNN的方法否定了感应器的好处,将事件汇总到稀疏的网格中. 这对夫妇计算出感应分辨率的成本 并模糊时间信息。 同时,现有的基因基线取决于是否有轨迹数据来预演模型。 我们提出FLEET(通过高效Tokenization对事件进行 Feature Learning from Earths),这是直接处理事件序列的特性提取器. 利用随机的Fourier特性和交叉意向,我们的架构将可变流压缩成固定大小的潜在表示. 这种脱钩推论成本将特性提取器的骨干从传感器的分辨率中提取出来,使得端到端的学习没有辅助损失. 我们在一个新的高通量基准上验证FLEET. 结果显示,我们基于序列的方法超过了SOTA的性能,表现出比观测频率变化强的强。

articles.title: Matched Outcomes, Divergent Gaze: How Foveated MLLMs Search Compared to Humans
articles.content: Human visual search is serial: the fovea must land on a candidate to confirm it, and those landings form a scanpath. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs), given the same foveated input, search as humans do bears on their use as models of human vision and on attention-alignment scores. We compare three general-purpose MLLMs with human eye-movement scanpaths on goal-directed search (COCO-Search18), driving each model fixation by fixation through an identical, human-matched foveated view and assessing it along three axes: the decision of target presence, the efficiency of reaching the target, and the gaze process itself. The axes dissociate. On the decision and on target acquisition the models match or exceed humans, detecting present targets near ceiling and reaching them on the first saccade more often than people do. The gaze process is not human. Under the human-matched condition, all three share one signature: low-entropy, large-amplitude, self-consistent scanpaths that agree with themselves far more closely than two humans agree with each other. That is consistent with a single-pass, non-serial architecture rather than a limit of acuity. Matched retinal input reproduces where humans look but not how the looking unfolds in time, and no degradation regime recovers human-like search at human-like success. The gap sits on a process axis that answer-alignment and saliency metrics do not measure. Because they miss it, such metrics cannot certify human-like vision, and zero-shot models suit outcome and spatial questions but not temporal, process-level ones.

articles.title_zh: 匹配结果, divergent Gaze: 与人类相比如何 Foveded MLLMs 搜索
articles.content_zh: 人类的视觉搜索是连续的:fovea必须降落在候选人身上才能确认,而那些着陆形成扫描路径. 无论是多模式大语言模型(MLLMs),由于相同的foved输入,与人类一样的搜索会影响其作为人类视觉模型的使用以及注意力对齐的分数. 我们比较了三个通用的MLLMs和在目标定向搜索(COCO-Search18)上的人类眼动扫描路径,通过一个相同的、人与人相匹配的圆形视野,通过固定来驱动每个模型固定,并按三个轴线来评估:目标存在的决定,达到目标的效率,以及凝视过程本身. 斧头断裂。 在决定和获取目标时,模型与人类相匹配或超过人类,在天花板附近发现现有目标,并在第一个圣杯上比人们更频繁地到达它们。 凝视过程不是人类。 在人类比对条件下,所有三个都有一个特征: 低摄氏度,大放大度,自相容的扫描路径,与自己一致的远比两个人类彼此一致的要紧密得多. 这符合单一通道、非连续结构,而不是谨慎的限度。 匹配的视网膜输入可以复制人类的外观,但不能及时复制外观,任何退化制度都不能恢复人类对类似人类的成功的搜索. 空隙位于一个解答-对齐和显要度量度不测量的过程轴上. 因为它们错过了它,这样的度量衡无法证明类似人的视觉,零镜头模型适合结果和空间问题,而不是时间,过程层面的问题.

articles.title: MLLM-Guided Semantic Correction for Text-to-Video Generation
articles.content: Recent advances in diffusion models and Transformer architectures have led to significant progress in text-to-video generation. However, these models often suffer from semantic errors such as missing objects, incorrect attributes, or mismatched actions. Although some semantic correction methods perform optimization before sampling or refinement after sampling, how to detect and correct semantic deviations during the video generation process remains underexplored. In this paper, we introduce a training-free, interpretable mid-generation correction framework that integrates multimodal large language model (MLLM) feedback directly into the diffusion sampling loop. Our framework achieves diffusion trajectory correction by injecting semantic evaluation signals during video synthesis, enabling the model to optimize the generated content through continuous self-reflection. We propose two key modules: a Semantic Assessment Supervisor that generates intermediate preview frames for semantic evaluations and deviation diagnostics, and a Semantic Modification Assistant that corrects semantic drift during inference via a controllable latent trajectory intervention. Our method improves semantic alignment, visual fidelity, and temporal consistency without modifying model parameters. We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MLLM - Guided语义校正,用于文本到视频生成
articles.content_zh: 最近传播模型和变形器架构的进步导致文本到视频生成的显著进展. 然而,这些模型经常出现语义错误,如缺少对象,属性不正确,或动作不匹配. 虽然一些语义校正方法在采样或采样后的精细化之前进行优化,但在视频生成过程中如何检测和纠正语义偏差仍然没有得到充分的探索. 在本文中,我们引入了无培训,可解释的中代校正框架,将多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)反馈直接纳入扩散采样循环. 我们的框架通过在视频合成过程中注入语义评价信号来实现传播轨迹的校正,使模型能够通过持续的自我反射来优化生成的内容. 我们提出两个关键模块:一个为语义评估和偏差诊断生成中间预览框架的语义评估主管和一个语义修改助理,通过可控制的潜在轨迹干预在推论中纠正语义漂移。 我们的方法在不修改模型参数的情况下,提高了语义的对齐性,视觉的忠诚性,以及时间的一致性. 我们通过跨越多个基准的广泛试验来验证我们的方法的有效性。

articles.title: OccamView: Object-Conditioned View Selection for Frame-Budgeted Active 3D Gaussian Reconstruction
articles.content: Active 3D Gaussian reconstruction fundamentally relies on selecting informative next-best views under limited sensing budgets. Existing active 3DGS methods primarily plan viewpoints according to geometric information gain, treating object-induced hidden regions in the same manner as general unexplored space. Under tight frame budgets, such geometry-driven strategies may prioritize global scene coverage while leaving partially observed objects incompletely reconstructed. To address this limitation, we propose OccamView, an object-conditioned view-selection framework for frame-budgeted active 3D Gaussian reconstruction. Rather than predicting unseen object geometry or performing shape completion, OccamView maintains an online object memory from open-vocabulary detections grounded in measured RGB-D observations and represents unresolved local occupancy around detected objects as conservative hidden-region proxies. Candidate viewpoints are then evaluated using an occlusion-aware proxy-coverage score. Furthermore, we introduce a Geo-Floor mechanism that restricts object-conditioned re-ranking to geometrically competitive candidates, allowing object-conditioned cues to guide complementary observations while preserving the geometry-driven exploration behavior of the underlying planner. Experiments on Replica and Matterport3D under a unified frame-budgeted protocol show that OccamView consistently reduces Completion and improves Completion Ratio across five frame budgets, with particularly pronounced gains under limited frame budgets. These results demonstrate that lightweight object-conditioned cues effectively complement geometry-driven active view planning.

articles.title_zh: OccamView: 对象条件化 查看框架预算的 3D 高斯重建选项
articles.content_zh: 积极的3D高斯重建从根本上依赖于在有限的感知预算下选择信息性次佳的观点. 现有的主动3DGS方法主要根据几何信息增益来规划视角,以与一般未探索空间相同的方式处理物体引起的隐藏区域. 根据严格的框架预算,这种几何驱动战略可能优先覆盖全球,而部分观测到的物体则无法完全重建。 为了解决这一限制,我们提议OccamView,这是框架预算活跃的3D高斯重建的以对象为条件的视图选择框架。 OccamView没有预测未见物体几何或进行形状的完成,而是从基于测量到的RGB-D观测结果的开放-vocabulary探测中维持在线物体内存,并代表着未解决的局部占用被探测物体周围作为保守的隐藏区域代理. 然后使用隐蔽-意识代理覆盖分数来评价候选人的观点。 此外,我们引入了一种地理-氟化物机制,将有条件的物体重新排位限制在几何竞争对手,允许有条件的物体提示指导补充观测,同时保留基本规划者的几何驱动勘探行为。 根据统一框架预算协议进行的复制和matterport3D实验表明,OccamView在五个框架预算中不断减少完成率,改进完成率,在有限框架预算下特别显著地有所收益。 这些结果显示,轻量级物体条件提示有效补充了几何驱动的主动视图规划.

articles.title: Towards Real-Time and Adaptable LiDAR Scene Completion
articles.content: LiDAR scene completion is a key component of 3D perception in autonomous driving, where the scene must be completed in real time to be usable in downstream tasks. Existing approaches typically follow an initialize-and-refine paradigm, in which a coarse initialization of the scene is first constructed, then refined into complete 3D geometry. Generative models are slower because they iteratively refine random Gaussian noise into the scene, while non-generative methods perturb the partial scene with a fixed noise scale, which limits coverage of large gaps and occluded regions and requires manual recalibration for each new sensor configuration. We present RapidLiDAR, a LiDAR scene completion method that treats the initialization itself as a learned, data-driven component. We propose an adaptive initialization module that predicts a spatially varying displacement for each partial input point, expanding the partial observations into a coarse scene initialization adapted to the local geometry, without requiring manual noise tuning. To refine this coarse initialization into a complete and coherent scene, we additionally propose a multi-scale reconstruction module that further refines point positions by querying multi-scale 3D voxel and 2D BEV feature maps constructed from the input scan. By replacing point-neighborhood operators such as farthest point sampling and $k$-nearest neighbor search with voxel- and BEV-based feature extraction, our architecture is faster and can handle different input resolutions by design. Experiments on SemanticKITTI and KITTI-360 show that our method achieves completion performance on par with the state of the art while completing a full scene in 0.1 seconds, which is 2.3 times faster than the fastest prior method. This matches the 10 Hz acquisition rate of typical automotive LiDAR sensors, taking a step toward real-time LiDAR scene completion.

articles.title_zh: 走向实时和可适应的LiDAR 场景完成
articles.content_zh: LiDAR场景完成是自主驾驶中3D感知的关键组成部分,场景必须实时完成才能用于下游任务. 现有方法一般遵循一个初始化和refine的范式,其中首先构建粗糙的场景初始化,然后精炼成完整的3D几何. 基因模型较慢,因为它们迭代地将随机高斯噪音精炼成场景,而非基因方法则以固定的噪声尺度扰动部分场景,这限制了大缺口和渗漏区域覆盖范围,需要人工重新校正每个新的传感器配置. 我们提出RapidLiDAR,一种LiDAR场景完成方法,将初始化本身视为一个有知识,数据驱动的组件. 我们提出一个适应性初始化模块,预测每个部分输入点的空间差异转移,将部分观测扩展为适合局部几何的粗糙场景初始化,而不需要人工噪声调音. 为了将这种粗糙的初始化精炼成一个完整而连贯的场景,我们又提出一个多尺度的重建模块,通过查询从输入扫描中构建的多尺度3D voxel和2D BEV特征图来进一步完善点位置. 通过用 Voxel 和 BEV 特性提取来取代最远点采样和最近点搜索等点近点操作器,我们的架构更快,可以通过设计处理不同的输入分辨率. 在语义学KITTI和KITTI-360上的实验显示,我们的方法实现了与艺术状态等效的完成性能,同时在0.1秒内完成了完整的场景,比之前最快的方法快2.3倍. 这与典型的汽车LiDAR传感器的10赫兹获得率相匹配,朝着实时LiDAR场景完成迈出了一步.

articles.title: HiFi-BRep: High-Fidelity Latent Representation for Robust B-Rep Generation
articles.content: Boundary representation (B-Rep) generation is a fundamental task in computer-aided design, yet the direct synthesis of high-fidelity and structurally valid B-Reps remains a major challenge. Existing deep generative methods suffer from two forms of brittleness: representation brittleness, caused by padding noise and feature contamination in the latent space, and generation brittleness, stemming from sequential error propagation and a train-inference mismatch due to non-differentiable validity enforcement. We propose HiFi-BRep, a novel framework that addresses these limitations through two synergistic contributions. First, a topology-aware encoder constructs a high-fidelity latent representation by eliminating padding via learnable queries and preventing feature contamination with topology-guided attention. Second, a single-stage decoder jointly predicts geometry and topology in parallel, embedding core manifold constraints as a differentiable learning objective. This design ensures mutual guidance between geometry and topology while avoiding cascaded errors. Extensive experiments show that HiFi-BRep significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both structural validity and geometric fidelity, providing a robust solution for high-quality B-Rep synthesis. Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep.

articles.title_zh: HiFi-BREP:勃艮第B-Rep代号的高纯度后期代表
articles.content_zh: 边界代表(B-Rep)生成是计算机辅助设计中的一项基本任务,然而,直接合成高真实性和结构上有效的B-Rep仍然是一项重大挑战. 现有的深层遗传方法有两种形式的脆性:一种是隐蔽噪音和潜在空间特征污染造成的表现脆性,另一种是产生脆性,其原因是相继发生的错误传播和火车推论不匹配,因为执行的有效性是无差别的。 我们提议HiFi-BRep,这是一个通过两个协同贡献来克服这些局限性的新框架。 首先,一个具有地貌意识的编码器通过消除通过可学习的查询进行粘贴,防止地貌受到地形指导的污染,从而构建出一种高度真实性的潜在代表。 第二,单级解码器共同预测几何学和地貌平行,嵌入核心多重约束作为不同的学习目标. 这种设计确保了几何学和地形学之间的相互指导,同时避免了连锁错误. 广泛的实验表明,HiFi-BRep在结构有效性和几何忠诚性方面都大大超过最先进的方法,为高质量的B-Rep合成提供了有力的解决方案. 守则和模型可在https://github.com/1nnoh/HiFi-BRep上公开查阅。

articles.title: Remote-Sensing City Layout Extraction with MLLM
articles.content: Remote-sensing systems usually describe urban content with detection boxes, semantic masks, or vector boundaries. Such outputs locate classes and support image-plane scoring, yet they do not by themselves constitute an executable layout that retains object identities, typed relations, topology, and regeneration rules. Code-as-City instead casts urban-layout extraction from a single top-down image as constrained code generation with a multimodal large language model (MLLM). An image model first produces an aligned five-class semantic layout prior. Three ordered MLLM passes use the image and this prior to recover roads, land-cover regions and relations, and buildings. Deterministic normalization converts the accumulated records into a city graph and a restricted layout program. Executing the program creates a renderable 3D city layout and an orthographic semantic projection over shared geometry. The projection admits pixel-level comparison with remote-sensing masks, while named objects, relations, and editing operations remain available for synchronized regeneration of both views. Evaluated on the 100 scenes of CityLayout-100, the complete framework obtains 41.1% mean intersection-over-union and 48.3% global intersection-over-union. This result provides quantitative evidence that visual observations can be translated into inspectable, editable city code with coupled planar and 3D outputs.

articles.title_zh: 带有MLLM的遥感城市布局
articles.content_zh: 遥感系统通常用检测箱,语义面具,或矢量边界来描述城市内容. 这类产出定位类和支持图像平面评分,然而它们本身并不构成保留对象身份、打字关系、地形和再生规则的可执行布局。 代号-as-City将从单一的自上而下图像中提取出来的城市显示为带有多式联运大语言模型(MLLM)的受限代码生成. 一个图像模型首先产生一个对齐的五级语义布局之前. 3个订购的MLLM通行证在恢复道路、土地覆盖区域和关系以及建筑物之前使用图像和图像。 决定性的正常化将累积的记录转换为城市图和限制性布局程序. 执行该程序可创建可渲染的3D城市布局和在共享几何之上的正体语义投影. 投影接受像素级与遥感口罩的比较,而命名对象,关系,编辑操作仍然可供同步再生两种观点. 对CityLayout-100的100场景进行评估后,整个框架获得了41.1%的中间交叉结合和48.3%的全球交叉结合. 这一结果提供了定量证据,可以将视觉观测转化为可检查,可编辑的城市代码,并配有平面输出和3D输出.

articles.title: RISE: Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding across 3D Tracking and Structured Vision-Language Reasoning
articles.content: We present RISE (Roadside Infrastructure Sequence Understanding and Evaluation), a framework spanning metric 3D tracking and structured vision-language reasoning in roadside sequences. For metric tracking, our image-only method combines SAM3 video identities with calibration-guided mask agreement for multi-view identity association, recovering persistent 3D tracks without LiDAR or task-specific 3D training. Its calibration-conditioned geometry allows the procedure to be instantiated at different calibrated multi-camera intersections without layout-specific retraining. On 20 human-reviewed clips from six intersections, the generated tracks achieve 66.9 MOTA within the defined multi-view evaluation scope. For structured vision-language reasoning, a human-reviewed MLLM pipeline mines high-value clips and uses a constrained full-context Oracle to construct bbox-grounded predictive QA without exposing future evidence to evaluated models. The resulting RISE-VQA dataset contains 33,910 QA pairs from 557 clips across 16 intersections and 61 roadside views. Its intersection-held-out RISE-Bench evaluates semantic choices, coordinates, future boxes, and interaction sets with deterministic task-specific metrics. Experiments show consistent benefits from domain adaptation and generally from temporal context, while revealing persistent challenges in spatial grounding, future localization, and interaction reasoning.

articles.title_zh: RISE:路边基础设施 了解三维跟踪和结构化视野-语言的序列
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍RISE(路边基础设施序列理解和评价),这是一个涵盖衡量三维跟踪和路边序列结构化愿景语言推理的框架。 对于度量追踪,我们只使用图像的方法将SAM3视频身份与校准制导的面具协议结合起来,用于多视图身份关联,在不进行LiDAR或任务特定3D训练的情况下回收持久性3D音轨. 它的校准条件几何可以使该程序在不同的校准多相机交叉点被即时化,而无需进行具体布局的再培训. 在来自6个交叉点的20个人文审查片段上,生成的音轨在定义的多视图评价范围内实现了66.9 MOTA. 对于结构化的视觉语言推理,经过人审查的MLLM管道矿井高值的夹片,并使用受约束的全文本甲骨文构建bbox-grounded expective QA而不向被评价的模型暴露未来的证据. 由此而来的RISE-VQA数据集包含33,910对QA,从557个夹片穿过16个交叉点和61个路边视图. 它的交叉控股的RISE-Bench评价语义选择,坐标,未来框,以及具有确定性任务特定指标的交互集. 实验显示,域内适应和一般时间背景带来持续的利益,同时揭示了空间地面、未来本地化和互动推理方面的持续挑战。

articles.title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
articles.content: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.

articles.title: Shared-Structure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation for Sparse-View Spectral CT Reconstruction
articles.content: Sparse-view spectral computed tomography (CT) reconstructs energy-resolved attenuation volumes from limited projection views, requiring simultaneous handling of angular undersampling and spectral coupling. We propose a SharedStructure 4D Spectral Gaussian Representation (4D-SG) that learns shared Gaussian geometry from full spectrum structural projections and uses a Gaussian-wise Spectral Density Curve Network (GSC-Net) to predict Gaussian raw density transformations. This factorization separates shared spatial structure from spectral attenuation variation, avoids independent channel geometry optimization, and establishes a continuous 4D-SG representation from discrete spectral measurements for unobserved spectral channel queries. Experiments on six synthesized, simulated projection, and real projection datasets with 50 views demonstrate the best average performance. Compared with the strongest Gaussian baseline, 4D-SG improves PSNR from 35.56 dB to 36.61 dB, increases SSIM from 0.909 to 0.914, and reduces LPIPS from 0.208 to 0.194, demonstrating its effectiveness for sparse-view spectral CT reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: Sparse-View Spectoral CT 重建共用结构 4D 光谱高斯代表
articles.content_zh: Sparse-view光谱计算成谱图(CT)从有限的投影角度重建能量-解衰减体积,需要同时处理角底取样和光谱耦合。 我们提出一个共享结构 4D Spectral Gaussian代表(4D-SG),从全谱结构预测中学习共享的Gaussian几何学,并使用高斯智慧的Spectral密度曲线网络(GSC-Net)来预测高斯的原始密度转变. 这种因子化将共享的空间结构与光谱衰减变异区分开来,避免了独立的通道几何优化,并为无观测光谱通道查询的离散光谱测量建立了连续的4D-SG代表. 对6个合成,模拟投影的实验,以及50种观点的实际投影数据集,显示了最佳平均性能. 与最强的高斯基线相比,4D-SG将PSNR从35.56 dB改进为36.61 dB,将SSIM从0.909增加至0.914,将LPIPS从0.208减少至0.194,证明了其对短视光谱CT重建的有效性.

articles.title: Contrastive Energy Fields for Inference-Time Procedure Planning in Instructional Videos
articles.content: Procedure planning seeks to estimate a sequence of actions to transition from an observed initial state to a given goal state. Current procedure planning approaches directly predict action sequences from latent representations using feed-forward neural networks or diffusion-based inference. These paradigms treat every action as plausible, lacking the ability to enforce task-specific logical constraints that render certain actions irrelevant or not plausible. We propose CEFITO, a procedure planning approach that learns a predictor to express an action-conditioned representation space. Based on this representation space, we formulate procedure planning as a task-constrained optimization problem. Unlike prior methods, CEFITO explicitly reasons over the action space by omitting irrelevant actions during inference-time planning. This reformulation enables effective procedure planning and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on two established procedure planning benchmarks.

articles.title_zh: 教学录像中用于推论-时间程序规划的对比能源领域
articles.content_zh: 程序规划旨在估计一系列从观察到的初始状态向特定目标状态过渡的行动。 现行程序规划方法直接利用向导神经网络或基于传播的推论,从潜在表达中预测行动序列。 这些范式认为每一项行动都是可信的,缺乏执行特定任务逻辑限制的能力,使某些行动变得无关紧要或不合理。 我们提出CEFITO,一种程序规划方法,该方法学习预测器来表达行动条件的表示空间. 基于这一代表空间,我们制定程序规划,作为一个受任务限制的优化问题。 与以前的方法不同,CEFITO通过在推论时间规划中省略无关的行动,对动作空间有明确的理由. 重新拟订后,就可以进行有效的程序规划,并使两个既定的程序规划基准达到最新水平。

articles.title: Joint Flow Matching Enables Continuous Dose-Conditioned Cell Morphing
articles.content: Generative modeling has shown increasing promise for predicting cellular perturbation effects under chemical compound treatments. Existing approaches either model perturbation as a distribution-to-distribution mapping without explicit concentration handling, or treat concentration as a discrete class label, precluding continuous dose control. We introduce a joint flow matching approach that simultaneously models cell latents and drug concentration via a dual-timestep formulation, enabling dose-conditioned single-cell morphing through the invertibility of flow matching. The joint formulation induces a monotonic dose-response geometry in latent space and additionally supports concentration estimation from cell morphology. As proof of concept, we further demonstrate generalization to an unseen dose held out during training. Empirically, our method achieves competitive or improved per-concentration metrics on two compounds compared with representative baselines, while enabling capabilities structurally unavailable to discrete-class methods.

articles.title_zh: 联合流量匹配启用连续剂量 细胞解析
articles.content_zh: 基因模型显示,在化学化合物处理下,预测细胞扰动效应的前景越来越大。 现有方法要么是在没有明确浓度处理的情况下将模型扰动作为分布到分布图,要么将浓度作为离散类标签处理,从而排除了持续的剂量控制。 我们采用联合流动匹配方法,同时通过双时步配方模拟细胞潜伏和药物浓度,通过流动匹配的不可逆性使剂量有条件的单细胞形态化. 联合配体在潜在空间诱导单质剂量-反应几何,并额外支持细胞形态学的浓度估计. 作为概念的证明,我们进一步表明,在训练期间,我们所持有的剂量是看不见的。 经验是,与具有代表性的基线相比,我们的方法在两种化合物上实现了竞争性或改进的每浓度度量,同时使结构上无法使用离散类方法。

articles.title: Self-Routed Tensor Adapters for Parameter-Efficient Universal Visual Adaptation
articles.content: Universal visual representations require adaptation mechanisms that adapt across heterogeneous domains without fragmenting knowledge into domain-specific modules. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts frozen visual foundation models efficiently, but standard low-rank adapters use a fixed subspace for all inputs, which can be restrictive when domains differ in style, background, and semantic context. MoE-based adapters improve specialization through multiple expert pathways, but often rely on external routers and large expert banks, adding parameters and separating routing from adaptation. We propose \textbf{Self-Routed Tensor Adapters}, a compact framework for multi-domain visual adaptation. SRTA projects each input into a low-rank space, computes routing weights from this representation using a learnable domain matrix, and uses these weights to blend slices of a shared Tucker core. This produces a sample-specific adaptation matrix without an external gating network, allowing shared visual factors to be reused while supporting domain-aware specialization. To strengthen pathway learning, we introduce a progressive depth-weighted routing objective that supervises routing decisions across adapter layers. Across five heterogeneous multi-domain visual classification benchmarks, SRTA achieves competitive or slightly stronger average accuracy than MoE-style PEFT baselines while using substantially fewer trainable parameters. At rank 64, SRTA uses 2.77M parameters in the 4-domain setting compared with 9.52M for MoLoRA, and 3.00M in the 6-domain setting compared with 14.31M. Overall, SRTA offers an effective accuracy-parameter trade-off for adapting visual foundation models toward universal multi-domain representations. \href{https://github.com/surajyadav-research/SRTA}{GitHub}

articles.title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Satellite-Based Analysis of Battle-Damaged Agricultural Fields in Ukraine
articles.content: Monitoring war-induced damage to agricultural land in Ukraine is important for understanding threats to food security, environmental stability, and post-war recovery. However, the development of computer-vision systems for satellite-based damage analysis is limited by the scarcity of labeled imagery, especially for damaged agricultural fields. This work investigates synthetic data augmentation as a method for improving classification under limited and imbalanced training data. We train class-conditional Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) architectures on real satellite images and use them to generate additional bombed and not-bombed agricultural-field samples. The generated images are used only for training augmentation, while all downstream evaluation is performed on an exclusively real test set. A Vision Transformer classifier is trained under multiple real and synthetic data configurations to measure the practical utility of each generative approach. The best configuration, based on balanced DDPM augmentation, improves accuracy from 84\% to 88\%, balanced accuracy from 67\% to 81\%, macro F1 from 65\% to 78\%, and recall for the underrepresented not-bombed class from 41\% to 69\%. These results demonstrate the potential of synthetic satellite imagery for data-scarce geospatial applications in war-affected regions.

articles.title_zh: 乌克兰战役受损农田卫星分析合成数据增强
articles.content_zh: 监测战争对乌克兰农田造成的破坏对于了解对粮食安全、环境稳定和战后恢复的威胁十分重要。 然而,由于缺乏贴有标签的图像,特别是受损农田的图像,用于卫星损害分析的计算机视觉系统的开发受到限制。 这项工作调查了合成数据扩充,将其作为在有限和不平衡的培训数据下改进分类的方法。 在真实的卫星图像上,我们培训具有阶级条件的基因扩散和扩散概率模型(DDPM)结构,并利用这些结构产生更多的被轰炸和未轰炸的农田样本。 生成的图像仅用于培训增强,而所有下游评价都是在一套完全真实的测试中进行的。 一个Visual Transformer分类器在多个真实和合成的数据配置下接受训练,以测量每种基因方法的实际效用. 最佳配置基于平衡的DDPM增强,提高准确度从84\%提高到88\%,平衡准确度从67\%提高到81\%,宏F1从65\%提高到78\%,对代表性不足的未轰炸类从41\%提高到69\%. 这些结果表明,合成卫星图像在受战争影响区域用于数据稀缺地理空间应用的潜力。

articles.title: Adaptive Post-Processing Drives Instance-Level Detection in Stroke Lesion Segmentation
articles.content: Instance-level lesion detection has been an increasingly larger focal point in medical image segmentation besides the more standard voxel-level overlap. Still, most pipelines are trained and post-processed for voxel overlap alone. In particular, the mismatch is most pronounced for small lesions, where a near-miss prediction---substantial overlap that falls just short of the instance-matching threshold---scores the same as a complete miss. In our ISLES'26 submission, we found that closing this gap mattered far more in post-processing than in architecture design. Our Volume-Conditioned Adaptive Post-Processing (VCAP) scheme adjusts component-size thresholds to each case's predicted lesion burden, improving Lesion-F1 by 0.032 (unbiased cross-fold estimate)---approximately 6 times larger than any architectural change we tested. A resolution-aware attention architecture (Viola2Plus), designed for small-lesion segmentation, shows why the distinction matters: it left small-lesion Dice unchanged but raised small-lesion detection rate by 3.7\%, a real effect voxel-overlap metrics alone would have missed. Under 5-fold cross-validation on the 1,453-case training set, our post-processed two-architecture ensemble achieves Dice 0.651 and Lesion-F1 0.614, versus 0.644 and 0.573 for the unprocessed single-model baseline.

articles.title_zh: 调整处理后磁盘实例级检测
articles.content_zh: 病例级的病症检测是医疗图像分解中日益扩大的焦点,此外还有标准级的毒物级重叠。 不过,大多数管道都经过了培训,经过后处理后,仅用于排毒。 特别是,不匹配最显著的是小损伤 近乎误差的预测... 大量重叠, 恰好与实例匹配阈值... 在我们的ISLES'26呈件中,我们发现,缩小这一差距在后处理中比在建筑设计中重要得多。 我们的量调性后处理(VCAP)计划根据每个案例的预计损伤负担调整组件大小阈值,将Lesion-F1改进0.032(无偏倚的交叉估计)——大约比我们测试过的任何建筑变化大6倍. 一种分辨率-意识的注意力架构(Viola2Plus),为小流分解设计,显示区别为何重要:它留下了小流 剂量没有改变,但小口径检测率上升了3.7%%, 仅仅一个真正的效果 voxel-overlap 度量表就会错过。 在1,453个案例集的5倍交叉验证下,我们经过处理的双结构组合实现了Dice 0.651和Lesion-F1 0.614,而未处理的单模型基线则为0.644和0.573。

articles.title: OceanDepths: A Global Dataset of Paired Subsurface and Surface Ocean Observations
articles.content: Despite comprising over 70\% of its surface, the world's oceans are critically underobserved compared to the land surface or the atmosphere.Understanding the global ocean requires jointly observing its surface and subsurface structure, yet no standardized, high-resolution dataset couples satellite surface fields to co-located \emph{in situ} depth profiles in an AI-ready format.Existing resources either consist of model-reconstructed gridded products rather than observations, cover only a single variable or basin, or operate at resolutions too coarse for mesoscale dynamics.We introduce \textsc{OceanDepths}, the first open, global, regridded AI-ready dataset that pairs satellite-derived sea surface temperature (SST), sea surface salinity (SSS), and sea surface height (SSH) L4 products with co-located EN4 subsurface temperature and salinity profiles, complemented by matched GLORYS12 ocean reanalysis data to support comparisons or multi-stage learning.The dataset spans 2000--2024 at \SI{0.1}{\degree}$\times$\SI{0.1}{\degree} spatial resolution and at weekly temporal resolution, covering the entire globe's sea surface and with over 9.5 million paired profiles interpolated to 50 standardized depth levels.We provide a configurable system to split the globe in equally sized spatial patches.The 4D multivariate structure, high resolution, long temporal extent, and extreme sparsity of subsurface observations (${\sim}$0.01\% per depth level) make \textsc{OceanDepths}a challenging testbed for novel AI methods.We demonstrate subsurface state reconstruction as an example task with simple baseline models, but also envision \textsc{OceanDepths}to support the development of observation-based forecast methods and other related tasks.\added{Available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ESA-philab/OceanDepths.}

articles.title: Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection for Natural Scenes
articles.content: To date, all natural scene skeleton detection follows the paradigm of taking RGB images as the sole input; despite notable progress, methods under this paradigm suffer significant performance degradation on complex-content images. We observe that depth images are inherently insensitive to color and texture, and can provide clear regional contours and inter-region spatial relationships, which naturally alleviates the difficulty of skeleton detection in complex scenarios. Motivated by this observation, this paper proposes for the first time a novel skeleton detection paradigm where depth images serve as the dominant modality and RGB images act as the auxiliary, and accordingly presents a model DDSkel (short for Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection) under this paradigm. DDSkel employs an asymmetric encoder design to fuse RGB information into depth features, with the RGB modality branch having only 12% the parameters of the depth modality branch. DDSkel has a simple structure without intricate designs. Nevertheless, with only 36% of the trainable parameters of the current best method, DDSkel outperforms all state-of-the-art approaches on SymPASCAL, the most challenging dataset with a large volume of complex images.

articles.title_zh: 用于自然场景的深度- 支配力 Skeleton 检测
articles.content_zh: 迄今为止,所有自然场景骨架检测都遵循了将RGB图像作为唯一输入的范式;尽管取得了显著进展,但这一范式下的方法在复杂内容图像上受到显著性能退化. 我们注意到,深度图像对颜色和纹理内在不敏感,可以提供清晰的区域轮廓和区域间空间关系,这自然减轻了复杂情景下骨架探测的难度. 基于这一观察,本文首次提出了一个新的骨架检测范式,其中深度图像作为主导模式,RGB图像作为辅助模式,并因此在此范式下提出了DDSkel模型(Depth-Dominant Skeleton Detection的简称). articles.title: DriveCache: Action-Aware Caching for Driving World Model Inference
articles.content: Driving video generation models support autonomous-driving development by predicting controllable future scenes for simulation, planning evaluation, and offline data generation. Diffusion-based driving generators repeatedly evaluate large backbones across denoising steps, which limits generation throughput. Existing diffusion acceleration methods reduce this cost, but general-purpose designs omit driving signals available before generation, such as ego speed and planned trajectories. Experiments across driving motions show that cache tolerance varies with ego translation and rotation, denoising progress, and consecutive reuse length. We propose DriveCache, a training-free, action-aware controller that uses planned motion to allocate reuse across scenes and dynamic programming to place it across denoising steps under a calibrated response budget. A causal drift check refreshes features and replans the remaining schedule when generation departs from calibration. Across three generator configurations, DriveCache improves the overall fidelity-efficiency trade-off over evaluated cache methods. Our code will be publicly available.

articles.content_zh: 驱动视频生成模型通过预测模拟、规划评价和离线数据生成的可控未来场景,支持自主驱动开发。 基于扩散的驱动发电机反复对大骨干进行跨调试步骤的评价,这限制了生成的吞吐量. 现有的传播加速方法降低了这一成本,但通用设计省略了生成前可用的驱动信号,如自负速度和计划中的轨迹. 跨越驱动运动的实验表明,缓存耐受性随自我翻译和旋转、否认进步以及连续重复使用长度而不同。 我们提议DriveCache, 一个没有训练的,有行动意识的控制器, 利用计划的运动, 分配跨场景的再利用和动态的编程, 将它跨解密步骤置于一个校准的反应预算之下。 一次因果漂移检查刷新了特性,并在生成脱离校准时重新规划剩余的时间表. articles.title: SIGMA-Lane: Scale-pyramId Gated MAmba for Temporally Consistent Video Lane Detection
articles.content: Video lane detection requires predictions that remain stable across frames, yet severe vehicle occlusions can break temporal cues. In streaming recurrent models, corrupted observations may enter the hidden state and produce errors that persist into later frames. Existing occlusion-aware refinements usually provide obstacle masks as auxiliary inputs, so the state-update path is only indirectly protected. We propose SIGMA-Lane, which treats this failure mode as state contamination in State Space Model (SSM)-based temporal modeling. SIGMA-Lane places occlusion-aware gates on the SSM write and residual-fusion paths, controlling how current observations enter temporal memory and are fused back after temporal propagation. After coordinate-consistent affine alignment, the model combines two complementary paths: SSM-consistent dual-gating for temporal filtering and Structural Spatial Retrieval (SSR) for recovering missing lane structure from aligned historical priors. Experiments on VIL-100 and OpenLane-V show improved temporal stability under heavy occlusion, with competitive F1 and mIoU scores.

articles.title_zh: SIGMA- Lane: 缩放平面 Id Gated MAMBA 临时一致视频巷检测
articles.content_zh: 视频道检测需要预测在跨帧时保持稳定,但严重的车辆闭塞可以打破时间提示. 在串流的反复模式中,被腐蚀的观测可能进入隐藏状态,并产生持续到后方帧的错误. 现有的隐蔽-知觉改进通常提供障碍口罩作为辅助输入,因此状态更新路径只受到间接保护. 我们提议SIGMA-Lane,在基于国家空间模型(SSM)的时间模型中将这种故障模式视为状态污染。 SIGMA-Lane在SSM的书写和剩余聚变路径上放置了闭塞-感知门,控制当前观测如何进入时间内存,并在时间传播后被连接回. 该模型在协调一致的affine对齐后,结合了两种互补路径:用于时间过滤的SSM一致双轨对接和用于从对齐的历史往事中恢复缺失的车道结构的结构空间检索(SSR). 在VIL-100和OpenLane-V上的实验显示,在重聚下时间稳定性提高,具有竞争性的F1和mIoU分数.

articles.title: Unlocking Motion in Expressions: Temporal Calibration for Referring Video Object Segmentation
articles.content: Referring Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to segment referred objects at the pixel level in video sequences based on natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically introduce motion information within a unified cross-modal temporal modeling framework, where language cues are used for target localization and segmentation. However, the dependency of expressions on motion semantics is not explicitly modeled, making it difficult to adaptively adjust the use of motion information according to different semantic requirements. To address these issues, we propose an Expression-driven Motion Calibration (EMC) framework for RVOS that explicitly unlocks and leverages the motion semantics within expressions. The proposed method extracts interpretable motion control signals from expressions via a Motion Signal Processing (MSP) module, and employs a Motion Influence Calibration (MIC) module to adjust the contribution of motion cues during temporal decision making. In addition, a Semantic Temporal Stage Construction (STSC) module is introduced to build expression-relevant temporal stages, providing a compact temporal candidate space for motion calibration. Through extensive evaluation on six standard benchmarks, including Ref-YouTubeVOS, Ref-DAVIS17, MeViS (valid/valid$^u$), A2D-Sentences, and JHMDB-Sentences, the superiority of our method is validated. We will release the code on https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC.

articles.title_zh: 表达式中的解锁动作: 参考视频对象分片的调试
articles.content_zh: 参考视频对象分区(RVOS)旨在基于自然语言描述的视频序列中,将像素级的参考对象分区. 现有方法通常在统一的跨模式时间建模框架内引入运动信息,其中语言提示用于目标本地化和分区化. 然而,表达方式对运动语义的依赖性并没有被明确定型,因此很难根据不同的语义要求适应性地调整运动信息的使用. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了RVOS的表达驱动运动校准(EMC)框架,明确解锁并带动表达式中的运动语义. 拟议方法通过运动信号处理模块从表达式中提取可解释的运动控制信号,并使用运动影响校准模块在时间决策中调整运动提示的贡献. 此外,还引入了语义学临时阶段构建模块(STSC)来构建与表达相关的时间阶段,为运动校准提供了紧凑的时间候选空间. 通过对包括Ref-YouTubeVOS、Ref-DAVIS17、MeViS(有效/有效美元美元)、A2D-Sentences和JHMDB-Sentences在内的六个标准基准的广泛评价,我们的方法的优越性得到了验证。 我们将在https://github.com/Jeven7/EMC上发布代码。

articles.title: GRNEdit: Efficient General Video Editing from a New Binary-Evidence Perspective in Generative Refinement Networks
articles.content: Instruction-based general video editing seeks to unify diverse editing operations within a single, intuitive interface. Existing approaches often rely on resource-intensive conditioning, using either heavyweight branches or costly source concatenation. Is there any efficient way to model editing intent? Thus, we introduce GRNEdit, a lightweight two-stage framework. GRN inspires our approach by encoding visual semantics through combinations of bits. Through task-specific fine-tuning, we take this representation further and recast editing semantics as local retain-or-flip decisions over individual bits. Source information is consequently modeled as coordinate-wise evidence supporting the observed binary states, while the GRN backbone remains responsible for resolving their global composition into coherent generative semantics. In Stage I, a compact encoder translates discrete source codes into continuous evidence signals, which GRN assimilates throughout binary refinement. Inspired by null-prompt training for classifier-free guidance, we further assign the null condition an editing-specific meaning: an empty instruction denotes no edit and is supervised through source reconstruction. This identity pathway not only implicitly strengthens evidence utilization and content preservation in Stage I, but also produces a source-preserving state in the same representation space as the edited state. Stage II can therefore directly compare each edited state with its source-preserving counterpart and use their discrepancy to revise unresolved target-bit decisions. Trained on only 0.6M pairs with less than 3\% conditioning parameters, GRNEdit-2B and GRNEdit-8B achieve scores of 4.03 and 4.18 on OpenVE-Bench. The 2B model outperforms multiple 14B open-source editors, while the 8B model performs on par with leading open-source editors.

articles.title_zh: 绿色RN 编辑 : 从 Generative Finement Networks 的新二进制-证据视角中高效的普通视频编辑
articles.content_zh: 基于指令的普通视频编辑试图在单一的直观界面内统一多样的编辑操作. 现有方法往往依赖资源密集型的调节,使用重量级分支或昂贵的源汇。 是否有任何有效的模式编辑意图? 因此,我们引入了GNEdit,一个轻量级的两阶段框架。 GRN通过组合位元编码视觉语义来启发我们的方法. 通过针对特定任务的微调,我们更进一步地进行这种表述,并将编辑语义改编为本地保留或浮动决定单个位. 因此,原始资料被模拟为支持观测到的二进制状态的坐标证据,而GRN主干部门仍然负责将其全球构成溶解为连贯的基因语义。 在第一阶段,一个紧凑的编码器将离散源代码转换成连续的证据信号,GRN在二进制完善过程中将其同化. 受无分类器指导的无效瞬间训练的启发,我们进一步将无分类条件指定为编辑特定的含义:空指令表示不编辑,并通过源重建进行监督. 这种身份途径不仅隐含地加强了第一阶段的证据使用和内容保存,而且产生了与编辑状态相同的源保存状态。 因此,第二阶段可以直接将每个编辑状态与其源保存对应状态进行比较,并利用它们的差异来修改未解决的目标位决定. 仅训练了0.6M对,配置参数小于3×××××的GNEdit-2B和GNEdit-8B在OpenVe-Bench上取得了4.03和4.18的分数. 2B模型的性能超过了多个14B开源编辑器,而8B模型则与领先的开源编辑器平起平坐.

articles.title: LaGSplat: Inferring Physics-Governed Interactive Simulation from Monocular Video Using Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: We present LaGSplat (Latent Lagrangian Gaussian Splatting), a framework that infers interactive, physics-governed dynamics from one or a few monocular videos. At inference it lets a user push on the filmed object, rigid or deformable, with an external force that was never measured, annotated, or seen during training. This is possible because a low-dimensional latent state $\mathbf{q} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ plays two roles at once: it is the generalised coordinate of a learned dissipative Lagrangian and the conditioning variable of a Gaussian Splatting decoder. The inductive bias of this decoder, whose primitives are explicit points $μ_i(\mathbf{q})$ that move with the object, is what lets a force $f$ applied in the image pull back into a latent generalised force $J(\mathbf{q})^\top f$ and enter the equations of motion, which pixel-space (CNN) or neural-field (NeRF) decoders cannot do. We validate LaGSplat on test cases of increasing difficulty, from rigid to deformable and from autonomous to forced real systems, combining monocular video and sensor measurements. We further demonstrate interactive use: forces of arbitrary magnitude and direction can be applied to the reconstructed object at any time, its response rendered in real time, in 2D or 3D. Assuming a dissipative Euler-Lagrange equation over a few generalised coordinates trades generality for a bounded, plausible response to unseen forces, where an unconstrained predictor diverges.

articles.title: StreamOPD: A Post-Training Recipe with Spatio-Temporal Cue Gating for Streaming Video Understanding
articles.content: Streaming video understanding demands direct responses from the causally observed prefix of an unfolding video. Existing systems add inference-time memory, retrieval, and compression, yet a training-free sliding-window baseline already matches them. We therefore fix a memory-free recent-window protocol and ask how far post-training alone can go. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards fits this regime poorly, encouraging long ``think-then-answer'' generations, while on-policy distillation (OPD) supplies dense token-level teacher supervision on student trajectories but is stable only when both models train in thinking mode. These observations lead to \textsc{StreamOPD}, a recipe combining verifiable streaming-video data, thinking-mode OPD, and instruct-mode deployment. It raises StreamingBench from $77.9\%$ to $83.9\%$---within $0.3$ points of the 9B teacher---and improves OVO-Bench excluding its hallucination-detection subtask (HLD) by $9.1$ points under unchanged inference. As a teacher-privilege extension, \emph{Spatio-Temporal CueGate (ST-CueGate)} aggregates cue-versus-no-cue teacher likelihood ratios into a group-relative response score that reweights OPD. It reaches $71.9\%$ on OVO-Bench (excluding HLD) and $64.9\%$ on Video-MME, and is the only variant that stays above the base model on all four benchmarks. Replacing the teacher with a frozen copy of the student's initial policy---on-policy self-distillation---retains most of these gains and lifts HLD to $57.0\%$, above both the untrained student and the 9B teacher, so abstention loss is not intrinsic to the recipe. We provide a transparent and reproducible reference for open-source streaming-video research.

articles.title_zh: StreamOPD:一个带有Spatio-Temperal Cue Gating用于流媒体理解的训练后配乐
articles.content_zh: 视频的流畅理解要求从一个正在播放的视频的因果观察前缀直接做出回应. 现有系统增加了推断时间内存、检索和压缩,但一个没有训练的滑动窗口基线已经与它们相符。 因此,我们确定一个无记忆的近期窗口协议,并询问单是训练后可以走多远. 强化的学习与可核查的奖励不相适应,鼓励长期“思索时回答”的一代人,而政策提炼(OPD)则对学生的轨迹提供密集的象征性教师监督,但只有在两个模型都训练思维模式时才稳定。 这些观测结果导致\textsc{StreamOPD},一种将可核查的流线-视频数据,思维-模式OPD,指令-模式部署相结合的配方. 将Bench从77.9美元提高到83.9美元-在9B教师的0.3美元分之内,并将OVO-Bench的幻觉探测子任务(HLD)除以不变推论外,提高9.1美元分数。 作为教师-特权的扩展,\emph{spatio-Temporal CueGate(ST-CueGate)} 汇总 cue-对-no-cue 师资概率比,成为组合相对反应的分数,重新加权OPD. 它在OVO-Bench(不包括HLD)和Video-MME上分别达到71.9美元和64.9美元,是在所有四个基准上保持高于基准模型的唯一变体. 将学生的初始政策- 政策自我消化- 保留下来, 我们为开源流视频研究提供了透明和可复制的参考.

articles.title: Deep Thought Alignment: Trajectory-Level Latent Distillation for Video Reasoning
articles.content: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) for video reasoning have long been hindered by the high computational cost of processing vast amounts of visual information. This dilemma motivates the transfer of the reasoning capabilities of large models to smaller, more efficient ones. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) offers a promising solution by matching output-token distributions along student-generated trajectories. However, video reasoning often depends on evidence accumulated across multiple frames. In this context, output-level supervision only captures information expressed through token predictions and does not directly constrain the latent representations formed during reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-OPD, which augments OPD with trajectory-level latent distillation. Specifically, our method focuses on the position at the end of each trajectory, where hidden states effectively summarize the accumulated visual evidence and reasoning context. Furthermore, we introduce a progressive teacher-lookahead strategy, which aligns middle-to-late student layers with increasingly deeper teacher layers. Experiments on six video reasoning benchmarks show that Latent-OPD consistently outperforms output-only OPD. Notably, the improvements are particularly pronounced in scenarios with limited frames, long videos, or tasks requiring complex evidence aggregation. These results establish Latent-OPD as a highly effective approach to frame-efficient video reasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 深思熟虑对齐:影像推理的轨迹级底片沉淀
articles.content_zh: 处理大量视觉信息的高昂计算成本长期以来阻碍了用于视频推理的大型多式联运模式。 这种困境促使大型模型的推理能力转移到较小、效率更高的模型。 On-Political Distruction(OPD)提供了一个很有希望的解决办法,按照学生创造的轨迹来匹配输出的按键分布. 然而,视频推理往往取决于跨多个帧积累的证据. 在这方面,产出一级的监督只捕捉通过象征性预测表达的信息,并不直接限制推理过程中形成的潜在表述. 为了消除这一局限性,我们提议Latent-OPD,通过轨迹级的潜在蒸馏增强OPD. 具体来说,我们的方法侧重于每个轨迹末端的位置,其中隐藏状态有效总结了累积的视觉证据和推理背景. 此外,我们推行了一项进步的师范战略,将中后期学生与越来越深的教师阶层联系起来。 对6个视频推理基准的实验表明,Latet-OPD的性能始终高于只输出的OPD. 值得注意的是,在帧有限、视频长或任务需要复杂证据汇总的情况下,改进尤为明显。 这些结果将Lateent-OPD确立为一种高效的帧视频推理方法.

articles.title: Cross-View Urban Sensing: Mapping Subjective Streetscape Perception via AlphaEarth Embeddings and Urban Context
articles.content: Residents' perception of the urban streetscape is an important factor in public health, active mobility, and social wellbeing. Street view imagery (SVI) has emerged as a widely used data source for assessing these perceptual qualities, yet its uneven coverage and irregular updating limit large-scale measurement. Here, we present CVLNet, a Cross-View Learning Network that predicts street-level perception from AlphaEarth embeddings and multi-source urban contextual data without requiring SVI at inference. CVLNet applies per-task adaptive gating to jointly model five perceptual dimensions, using labels from the pretrained SVI-Percept model as ground truth. The proposed method is evaluated across four Southeast Asian cities: Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, and Manila. CVLNet achieves a median road-segment-level Adjusted $R^{2}$ of 0.76 and consistently outperforms the baseline models, with gains ranging from 5.9--11.3% across the five perceptual dimensions. Ablation experiments show that AlphaEarth features and urban contextual features contribute complementary information. We further produce citywide road-level streetscape perception maps for five subjective perceptual dimensions across all four cities, extending perception estimation from the 13--31% of the road network directly covered by available SVI to the complete road network of each city. Integrating these maps with WorldPop gridded population data, we quantify exposure inequality across population-density, demographic, and land-use groups using the Deficit Palma Ratio. These results demonstrate that remote sensing can serve as a scalable alternative to SVI for citywide streetscape perception mapping, enabling a more comprehensive assessment of urban environmental inequality.

articles.title_zh: 跨视频城市感知:通过阿尔法地球嵌入和城市背景绘制主观街景感知图
articles.content_zh: 居民对城市街道风景的感知是公共卫生,积极流动,社会福利的重要因素. 街景图象(SVI)已经成为一种广泛使用的数据来源,用于评估这些感知性能,然而其不均衡的覆盖面和不规则的更新限制了大规模测量. 在这里,我们介绍CVLNet,一个跨视网学习网络,它从AlphaEarth嵌入和多源城市背景数据中预测街道层面的感知,而不需要SVI推论. CVLNet将每个任务适应性标注应用到联合模型五个感知维度,使用预先训练的SVI-Percept模型的标签作为地面真理. 在四个东南亚城市(新加坡、吉隆坡、雅加达和马尼拉)评价了拟议方法。 CVLNet实现了0.76美元的中位数路段一级调整,并始终超过基准模型,在五个概念层面的增益从5.9-11.3%。 校对实验显示,阿尔法地球特征和城市背景特征提供了补充信息。 我们进一步绘制全市道路一级街道景观感知图,以覆盖所有四个城市的五个主观感知维度,将感知估计从可用SVI直接覆盖的13%-31%的路网延伸到每个城市的完整路网. 将这些地图与WorldPop网格化的人口数据结合起来,我们用不足的帕尔马比率来量化人口密度、人口和土地使用群体之间的接触不平等。 这些结果表明,遥感可以作为SVI的可扩展替代品,用于绘制全市的街景感知图,从而能够更全面地评估城市环境不平等现象。

articles.title: PosterText: Towards Unified Visual Text Generation and Editing for E-commerce Poster
articles.content: Automated e-commerce poster design requires both high-quality poster generation and flexible editing of existing designs. However, most existing methods either target end-to-end poster generation or follow multi-stage design pipelines, with limited capability for flexible and precise editing of existing posters. To enable unified generation and editing of e-commerce posters, we introduce Text Patch Generation and Editing, a unified task formulation that treats text patches as atomic units and covers four operations: poster generation, patch addition, patch deletion, and patch modification, with optional reference-guided style control. Based on this, we propose PosterText, a unified model trained with a four-stage curriculum, including text rendering pretraining, instruction-following training, reinforcement learning for preference alignment, and spatial guidance self-distillation for execution refinement. We further construct a large-scale dataset with patch-level annotations and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PosterText achieves competitive performance against existing generation and editing approaches, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articles.title_zh: PosterText: 面向电子商务海报的统一视觉文本生成和编辑
articles.content_zh: 电子商务自动海报设计既需要高质量的海报制作,也需要对现有设计进行灵活的编辑。 然而,大多数现有方法要么针对端到端海报的生成,要么遵循多阶段设计管道,对现有海报进行灵活准确编辑的能力有限。 为了实现电子商务海报的统一生成和编辑,我们引入了文本补丁生成和编辑,一种将文本补丁作为原子单位对待并涵盖四个操作的统一任务配方:海报生成,补丁添加,补丁删除,以及补丁修改,带有可选的参考指导样式控制. 在此基础上,我们提出PosterText,一种经过四阶段课程培训的统一模式,包括文本预训、教学跟踪培训、强化学习以适应偏好,以及空间指导自我消化以完善执行。 我们进一步构建一个大型数据集,并附有补丁级说明和一个全面的评价基准。 广泛的实验表明,PosterText与现有生成和编辑方法相比,实现了竞争性的性能,验证了拟议框架的有效性。

articles.title: Audio-Visual Segmentation via Depth-Guided Collaborative Modeling
articles.content: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) is a fundamental task in multimodal perception that performs pixel-level segmentation of sounding objects in videos by leveraging both visual and audio cues. It has broad applications in video understanding, human-computer interaction, and autonomous driving. However, most existing AVS methods do not explicitly model geometric cues such as relative distance and occlusion, thereby limiting the robustness of cross-modal alignment. In human perception, spatial structure is naturally integrated with audio-visual evidence to accurately localize sounding objects. Motivated by this, we incorporate estimated depth as a spatial structural cue for AVS and propose DGCM-AVS, a tri-modal framework that jointly models audio, visual, and depth information. Specifically, we design a Depth-Aware Dynamic Modulator to improve the separation of adjacent objects while preserving intra-object feature consistency. Furthermore, we propose Depth-Guided Progressive Fusion, which uses depth as an intermediate bridge to progressively align audio cues with visual features. Compared to state-of-the-art methods, DGCM-AVS achieves relative improvements of 10.2 percent in M_J and 8.7 percent in M_F on the AVSS dataset. We believe our study highlights depth as a promising yet underexplored modality for AVS and may encourage further research in this direction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过深度指导协作模式进行视听分区
articles.content_zh: 视听片段(AVS)是多模式感知中的一项基本任务,通过利用视觉和音频提示对视频中的声音物体进行像素级片段。 它在视频理解,人机交互,自主驾驶方面有广泛的应用. 然而,大多数现有的AVS方法没有明确的模型几何提示,如相对距离和隐蔽,从而限制了跨模式对齐的稳健性. 在人类认知中,空间结构自然地与视听证据融合在一起,以准确定位测音物体. 以此为动力,我们把估计深度作为AVS的空间结构提示,并提出DGCM-AVS,即一个三模式框架,联合模拟音频、视觉和深度信息。 具体地说,我们设计了一个深度-Aware动态模块,以改善相邻对象的分离,同时保持对象内特征的一致性. 此外,我们提议采用深度引导的渐进式融合,将深度作为中间桥梁,逐步使音频提示与视觉特征保持一致。 与最先进的方法相比,DGCM-AVS在AVSS数据集上的相对改进率分别为M_J的10.2%和M_F的8.7%. 我们认为,我们的研究强调,深度是AVS的一种有希望但未得到充分探讨的模式,可能鼓励在这方面开展进一步研究。

articles.title: TransAnyText: Translating Arbitrary Text in E-commerce Images via Structured Visual Generation
articles.content: Cross-border e-commerce image translation is essential for global retail, where product images, banners, and detail pages need to be produced in different languages. Existing methods struggle to achieve accurate translation, faithful visual identity preservation, and easy-to-edit outputs, simultaneously. To address these challenges, we introduce TransAnyText, a structured visual code framework that reformulates image text translation as generating renderable HTML patches from source images and target languages. Our framework decouples semantic generation from pixel rendering: a vision-language model (VLM) handles visual understanding, cross-lingual translation, and structured visual generation, while a diffusion model performs background inpainting and pixel-level refinement, followed by deterministic rendering to synthesize the final image. Based on this formulation, we develop a three-stage post-training framework, where supervised fine-tuning (SFT) establishes the image-to-code mapping, privilege-gap weighted self-distillation (PWSD) improves the learning of style and layout tokens, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) further optimizes task-level performance. We further introduce TransAnyDataset and TransAnyBench, a multilingual dataset and benchmark for e-commerce image translation. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive performance against cascaded pipelines, open-source end-to-end models, and closed-source image editing systems, providing an effective, controllable, and editable solution for cross-border e-commerce image translation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Translate AnyText:通过结构化视觉生成将电子商务图像中的任意文本翻译
articles.content_zh: 跨界电子商务图像翻译对全球零售至关重要,需要用不同语言制作产品图像、横幅和细节页。 现有方法为同时实现准确的翻译,忠实的视觉特征保存,以及易于编辑的输出而挣扎. 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了TransAnyText,这是一种结构化的视觉代码框架,将图像文本翻译重新编译为从源图像和目标语言生成可翻译的HTML补丁. 我们的框架解耦语义生成从像素渲染:一种视觉语言模型(VLM)处理视觉理解,跨语言翻译,以及结构化的视觉生成,而扩散模型则进行背景印记和像素水平的改进,然后是决定性渲染以合成最终图像. 基于这一提法,我们开发了一个三阶段的训练后框架,由监督的微调(SFT)建立图像到代码的映射,特权-gap加权自我消化(PWSD)改进了风格和布局符号的学习,强化的学习可核查的奖励(RLVR)进一步优化了任务级别的性能. 我们还引进了TransAnyDataset和TransAny Bench,这是电子商务图像翻译的多语种数据集和基准。 广泛的实验表明,与级联管道、开源端对端模型和闭源图像编辑系统相比,具有竞争力,为跨境电子商务图像翻译提供了有效、可控制和可编辑的解决方案。

articles.title: CoM$^3$eT: A foundation model for medical image analysis through federated, multidimensional context integration
articles.content: Medical foundation models improve generalization when training AI models with limited labeled data, but remain confined to a single specialty, such as pathology or radiology, and to either sparse or dense outputs, such as classification or segmentation. Here, we present CoM$^3$eT (Co-representation Multidimensional Multitask Medical Transformer), a medical vision foundation model that unifies pathology and radiology, sparse and dense predictions, and two- and higher-dimensional inputs by modeling multidimensional context with attention. CoM$^3$eT outperformed other medical foundation models in an open competition spanning five tomographic, four whole-specimen, and three two-dimensional datasets, covering sparse and dense prediction tasks as well as report generation. When adapted across diverse clinical applications, training fewer than 2.5% of parameters achieved performance comparable to full fine-tuning, enabling research without access to high-performance GPU clusters. Applied to federated learning across hospitals, this approach achieved performance comparable to pooled-data training over internet connections and with consumer-grade hardware.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: (单位:3美元) 通过联合、多维环境整合进行医疗图像分析的基础模型
articles.content_zh: 医学基础模型在培训贴有有限标签数据的AI模型时会提高通论性,但依然局限于一个单一的特长,如病理或放射等,以及分类或分化等稀疏或密集的输出. 在此,我们介绍CoM$^3$eT(共同代表的多面性医疗任务变形器),这是一种医学视觉基础模型,它统一了病理和放射学,稀有和密集的预测,并通过对多面性背景进行模型化和注意,提供了二维和更高维度的投入. COM$^3$eT在一场涵盖5个地形图、4个全谱和3个二维数据集的公开比赛中表现优于其他医学基础模型,涵盖了稀疏和密集的预测任务以及报告生成。 如果在各种临床应用中进行调整,不到2.5%的参数实现了与全面微调相类似的性能,使得无法进入高性能GPU集群的研究成为可能. 这种方法适用于各医院的联邦学习,取得了与通过互联网连接和消费级硬件进行集合数据培训相类似的绩效。

articles.title: Seeing Before Answering: Training-Free Visual Layer Profiling for Vision-Language Models
articles.content: LLaVA-style Vision-Language Models (VLMs) pass visual tokens from a fixed late layer of the vision backbone, typically the penultimate one, to the language model. We first show that this hidden convention is fragile: across 2 VLMs and 7 image and video benchmarks, the default layer is sub-optimal in 13 of 14 model-task pairs, and the best layer shifts with both task and visual backbone. Finding that layer by exhaustive layer-wise inference is prohibitively expensive, and no better fixed default exists. We therefore ask whether layer usefulness can instead be predicted from representation geometry. We study matrix-based entropy, introduced for unimodal layer analysis, which we compute over sample-level visual embeddings as Visual Dataset Entropy (VDE); and Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distance, introduced for encoder-level VLM model selection, which we repurpose as a layer-wise visual--language alignment signal. Transferring these to LLaVA-based models is not obvious a priori: the vision tower is frozen while the multimodal projector is trained, so we profile both sides of the projector. We find that VDE transfers, and GW does not. Computed from 100 unlabeled task samples without downstream inference, pre-projector VDE tracks layer-wise accuracy and its top-ranked layers cover the oracle best layer on every task for the SigLIP-based LLaVA-Video, while giving region-level guidance for the CLIP-based Video-LLaVA. Post-projector profiles show that the projector reshapes visual geometry but does not erase the performance-relevant trend, leaving $\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$ the stronger signal. GW instead flattens after projection and is best read as an alignment diagnostic rather than a selector. VDE thus offers an interpretable, training-free policy that narrows the visual-layer search to a handful of candidates for limited downstream verification.

articles.title_zh: 回答前看:无培训视觉层 对视觉语言模型的剖析
articles.content_zh: LLaVA风格的Visual-Langage Models(VLMs)将视觉标志从视觉主干上固定后层,一般为倒数第二层,传入语言模型. 我们首先表明,这个隐藏的公约是脆弱的:跨越了2个VLM和7个图像和视频基准,默认的地层在14个模型任务对中的13个中是次优化的,最好的地层会随着任务和视觉主干而变化. 通过详尽的分层推论找到这一层是极其昂贵的,不存在更好的固定默认。 因此,我们问,能否从代表几何学中预测层的有用性。 我们研究基于矩阵的Entropy, 用于单模式层分析, 我们计算在样本层面的视觉嵌入作为视觉数据集Entropy(VDE); 和Gromov-Wasserstein(GW)距离, 用于编码器层面的VLM模型选择, 我们重用它作为分层的视觉语言对齐信号。 把这些转移到基于LLaVA的模型上并不是显而易见的先验:在多式投影仪训练时,视塔被冻结了,所以我们剖析出投影仪的两侧. 我们发现VDE转移, 而GW没有。 由100个没有下游推论的无标签任务样本计算出,投影前VDE轨迹分层精度及其上等分层覆盖了以SigLIP为基础的LLaVA-Video中每项任务的甲骨文最佳分层,同时为以CLIP为基础的Video-LLAVA提供了区域一级的指导. 投影后剖面显示投影机重塑了视觉几何,但并未抹去与性能相关的趋势,使$\mathrm{VDE}_{\mathrm{pre}}$成为更强大的信号. 反之,GW在投影后会扁平,最好读作对齐诊断,而不是选取. 因此,VDE提供了一个可解释、无培训的政策,将视觉层的搜索范围缩小到少数候选人,以进行有限的下游核查。

articles.title: Defake-o3: From Speculative Rationales to Verifiable Evidence for Explainable AIGI Detection
articles.content: The rapid progress of image generation models calls for AI-generated image (AIGI) detectors that are not only accurate but also explainable and reliable. While MLLM-based detectors can provide natural language explanations, existing methods often generate speculative rationales: they rely on vague or hallucinated artifacts, miss subtle localized flaws from the latest generators, and fail to provide evidence that can be visually verified. We present Defake-o3, an explainable AIGI detector that moves from speculative rationales to verifiable evidence. It combines interactive visual search with verifier-guided evidence alignment: the model iteratively zooms into suspicious regions to inspect fine-grained details, while an Evidence Verifier, trained from human verification annotations, provides reinforcement learning rewards that favor grounded evidence and penalize baseless claims. To support this objective, we construct GroundFake, a dataset designed for grounded explainable detection, with localized bounding-box evidence, human verification based on visual grounding and artifact specificity, corrected reasoning trajectories, and valid/invalid evidence supervision. We further introduce FakeFrontier, an out-of-distribution benchmark built from real images and outputs of 10 recent generators, together with an MLLM-based protocol for evaluating evidence quality and persuasiveness. Experiments on GroundFake, FakeFrontier, and additional out-of-distribution benchmarks show that Defake-o3 improves both detection accuracy and explanation quality, producing more localized, verifiable, and persuasive evidence.

articles.title_zh: Defake-o3:从表面解释性理由到可核实的证据,用于可解释的AIGI检测
articles.content_zh: 图像生成模型的快速进步需要AI生成的图像(AIGI)探测器,这些探测器不仅准确,而且可以解释和可靠. 虽然基于MLLM的探测器可以提供自然语言解释,但现有方法往往产生推测性的理由:它们依赖于模糊或幻觉的文物,错过了最新生成器的微妙的局部缺陷,并未能提供可视化验证的证据. 我们提出Defake-o3,一个可解释的AIGI探测器,它从推测理论转向可核查的证据. 它将交互式视觉搜索与核查者指导的证据校正结合起来:模型迭代地放大到可疑区域,以检查精细的细节,而证据校正者则从人类核查说明中培训出来,提供强化的学习奖励,有利于有依据的证据并惩罚毫无根据的指控。 为支持这一目标,我们构建了地面假象,这是一个为有根据的可解释检测而设计的数据集,有本地化的边框证据,基于视觉地基和文物特异性的人类验证,修正推理轨迹,以及有效/无效的证据监督. 我们进一步引入了FakeFrontier,这是一个基于最近10台发电机的真实图像和产出的分散基准,以及基于MLLM的用于评价证据质量和说服力的协议。 在地上假,假花地上作的实验以及额外的外出分配基准显示Defake-o3既能提高检测准确度又能提高解释质量,能产生更多本地化,可核查和有说服力的证据.

articles.title: SCOUT: Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-Vocabulary Editing of face Recognition Templates
articles.content: Face recognition templates are compact identity representations, yet they also encode rich semantic information about facial appearance. Prior work has shown that templates can be inverted to images or indirectly manipulated through image-editing pipelines, but direct semantic editing in template space remains largely unexplored. Existing interpretability methods for face recognition often rely on manual neuron inspection or predefined attribute labels, limiting scalability and semantic flexibility. To address this gap, we propose SCOUT (Semantic Concept Discovery for Open-VocabUlary Editing of Face Recognition Templates), an end-to-end framework for discovering and directly manipulating semantic concepts in face recognition templates using mechanistic interpretability. SCOUT learns sparse template representations, generates semantic hypotheses for latent features from natural-language descriptions, and validates their stability. The resulting features act as controllable semantic directions for direct editing, avoiding costly edit--re-encode pipelines. Experiments with face recognition models using CNN, ViT, and Swin backbones show that SCOUT discovers interpretable concepts beyond standard attribute labels and enables controllable, identity-aware template manipulation with negligible impact on identity matching. We further show that edited templates can subsequently be decoded with independent inversion models for visualization and evaluation.

articles.title_zh: SCOUT: 开放词汇的语义概念发现 编辑面部识别模板
articles.content_zh: 脸部识别模板是紧凑的身份表示,然而它们也编码了丰富的关于面部外观的语义信息. 先前的研究表明,模板可以通过图像编辑管道向图像倒转或间接被操纵,但模板空间中的直接语义编辑基本上仍未被探索. 现有的面部识别可解释性方法往往依赖于人工神经元检查或预先定义的属性标签,限制了可伸缩性和语义灵活性. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出SCOUT(Open-VocabUlary edition of Face Conference Templex),这是利用机械解释在面部识别模板中发现并直接操纵语义概念的端到端框架. SCOUT学习了稀疏的模板表示,从自然语言描述中生成潜伏特征的语义假设,并验证其稳定性. 由此而来的特点起到可控的语义方向的作用,用于直接编辑,避免昂贵的编辑-再编码管道. 使用CNN,VIT,和斯温骨干进行的脸相识别模型实验显示,SCOUT发现可解释的概念超出了标准属性标签,并允许可控,能识别的模板被操纵,对身份匹配的影响可忽略不计. 我们进一步显示,经过编辑的模板可以随后用独立的反向模型来解码,用于可视化和评价.

articles.title: Convolution-Free Holistic Multivariance Decomposition Layer for Efficient Hyperspectral Image Classification Tensor Networks
articles.content: Feature extraction for hyperspectral image classification is conventionally addressed using rigid tensor decompositions that fail to capture complex spatio-spectral interdependencies, or heavily parameterized convolutional neural networks that are computationally expensive. To overcome these limitations, this work introduces the Holistic Multivariance Decomposition (HMD) framework as a novel, end-to-end differentiable neural network layer. By explicitly separating independent single mode variations from cooperative higher dimensional interactions via learnable, matrix valued supports, the proposed HMD-0, HMD-1 and HMD-2 approximants are optimized jointly with a downstream classifier via backpropagation. Comprehensive evaluations across three benchmark HS datasets demonstrate that the higher level HMD layers achieve superior classification accuracy compared to classical learnable tensor baselines, including Tucker, Canonical Polyadic, and Tensor Train decompositions. Furthermore, HMD-1 and HMD-2 achieve a generalization capacity and training stability comparable to standard 2D and 3D-CNNs while requiring significantly fewer feature extractor parameters. These results demonstrate that the HMD framework provides a structurally robust substitute for traditional convolution in multidimensional HS image classification, offering high parameter efficiency and stability throughout the optimization process.

articles.title_zh: 高效高频谱的同质- 自由全相多变量分解层 图像分类
articles.content_zh: 用于超光谱图像分类的地物提取,通常采用刚性拉伸分解法进行处理,这种分解法无法捕捉出复杂的斯皮提欧-光谱间相互依存关系,或者大量参数化的演化神经网络,计算成本昂贵. 为了克服这些局限性,本作引入了"全能多变分解"(HMD)框架,作为一款全新的,端到端的神经网络层. 通过通过可学习,矩阵价值支持,明确区分独立单模式变异与合作高维度相互作用,通过回向传播,将拟议的HMD-0,HMD-1和HMD-2相近物与下游分级器联合优化. 对三个基准HS数据集的综合评价表明,与古典可学习的拉伸基线相比,更高层次的HMD分层实现了优越的分类精度,包括塔克,Canonical Polyadic,和Tensor Train分解. 此外,HMD-1和HMD-2还实现了与标准2D和3D-CNN相仿的通缩能力和训练稳定性,同时需要的特性提取参数要少得多。 这些结果表明,HMD框架在结构上为多维HS图像分类中的传统演化提供了强大的替代品,在整个优化过程中提供了高参数效率和稳定性.

articles.title: GaussianDWM++: Language-Grounded 3D Gaussian Driving World Model for Unified Scene Understanding, Editing, and Multi-Modal Generation
articles.content: Driving World Models (DWMs) have recently advanced rapidly with generative models, yet most existing methods mainly focus on conditional scene generation and lack explicit 3D scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, and controllable 4D editing capabilities. Moreover, commonly used point cloud, occupancy, or BEV representations make it difficult to achieve fine-grained alignment between textual information and the underlying 3D scene structure. To address these limitations, we propose a foundation-feature Gaussian driving world model that unifies scene understanding, language-grounded reasoning, controllable 4D editing, and multi-modal generation within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a foundation-feature Gaussian tokenizer that directly distills Qwen/SigLIP visual-language features into 3D Gaussian primitives, building a compact open-vocabulary Gaussian semantic field. We further design a geometry-aware Gaussian adapter that combines importance-aware hierarchical selection with text-conditioned Perceiver-style cross-attention to aggregate dense Gaussian primitives into compact world tokens. To improve representation compatibility, we introduce a KL-based Gaussian--image distribution alignment objective that aligns Gaussian world tokens with foundation image tokens. Based on the aligned Gaussian representation, our framework further supports instruction-controllable scene editing, including weather-conditioned generation and dynamic vehicle manipulation. Extensive experiments on broader driving benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across scene understanding, visual grounding, planning-oriented reasoning, and controllable 4D generation tasks. We will release the code and datasets publicly on Github.

articles.title_zh: GaussianDWM++: 三维高斯驾驶世界模型 统一场景理解,编辑,多模态生成
articles.content_zh: 驱动世界模型(DWMs)最近以基因模型迅速进步,然而大多数现有方法主要侧重于有条件的场景生成,缺乏明确的3D场景理解,语言基础推理,以及可控制的4D编辑能力. 此外,常用的点云,占用,或BEV的表示方式,使得文字信息与基础的3D场景结构难以实现精细相接. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提出一个基础地貌高斯驾驶世界模型,统一场景理解,语言地推理,可控地4D编辑,以及在一个框架内的多模式生成. 具体来说,我们引入了一种地基地-地平面高斯语代词器,直接将Quen/SigLIP的视觉语言特征分馏入3D高斯语原始语中,构建了紧凑的开放-地平面高斯语的语义场. 我们进一步设计了一种几何意识高斯适配器,将重视的分级选择与文字条件的Perceiver风格的交叉意向相结合,将稠密的高斯原始人集成为紧凑的世界符号. 为了提高代表相容性,我们引入了基于KL的高斯-图像分布对接目标,将高斯世界符号与地基图像符号相接. 基于对齐的高斯代表,我们的框架进一步支持可指令控制的场景编辑,包括有气象条件的生成和动态车辆操纵. 对更广泛的驱动基准的广泛实验表明,我们的方法实现了现场理解、视觉地面、面向规划的推理和可控的4D生成任务的最新性能。 我们将公开Github上的代码和数据集。

articles.title: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
articles.content: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for DWI, ADC and T2W completion, but not T1W. In a separate 200-case diagnostic assessment, AUCs for clinically significant cancer were 0.860 with acquired images, 0.841 with MSCNet and 0.797 with baseline-generated images. A locked 186-case three-hospital cohort supported multicentre transportability. These retrospective results support quality-controlled cross-modal reconstruction as an adjunct to acquired prostate MRI.

articles.title_zh: 具有多中心临床验证的不完整和退化前列腺核磁共振的跨模式基因模型
articles.content_zh: 缺失或退化的序列可以限制前列腺多参数核磁共振. 我们开发了MSCNet,这是重建现有对比和恢复已退化的收购的有序列条件的跨模式基因框架。 在完成的10个任务中,针对具体任务的MSCNet在结构上实现了0.818和0.798之间的平均相似性,最强的参照国与任务相对应;匹配能力分析显示,在损害忠贞性和边界保护方面存在较大差异。 在被蒙蔽了1000个案例的阅读器研究中,总体图像质量达到了预先指定的DWI,ADC和T2W完成的非贫化标准,但是没有达到T1W. 在另外200个病例的诊断评估中,临床显著癌症的AUC有0.860个已获得图像,0.841个已获得MSCNet,0.797个已获得基线生成图像。 一个锁有186个病例的三院群支持了多中心的可运输性。 这些追溯结果支持了质量控制的跨模式重建,作为获得的前列腺核磁共振的辅助.

articles.title: PCT-Prompt: A Prompt-Guided Transformer Framework for Dense Prediction Tasks in Point Clouds
articles.content: Standard Transformers have proven effective in point cloud object classification, but their performance in dense prediction tasks within complex scenes is often hindered by weak prior assumptions. To address this challenge, we propose PCT-Prompt, a novel framework that enhances standard Transformers by introducing a prompt-guided feature branch to improve performance in dense prediction tasks. The standard Transformer branch leverages pre-trained models for global feature extraction from point cloud data, serving as the backbone for processing high-level features. Meanwhile, the prompt-guided feature branch consists of two key components: a fine-grained feature extraction block that captures multi-scale geometric features using geometry-sensitive abstraction layer, along with the PnP-3D layer to integrate local context with global regularization. The second component, the prompt-refined feature learning block generates prompt tokens, which are subsequently refined through cross-attention mechanisms. Additionally, we introduce a prompt drop mechanism that progressively removes prompt information across Transformer layers, balancing local details and global consistency. Experimental results on the ShapeNetPart, S3DIS, and DALES datasets demonstrate that PCT-Prompt significantly improves the adaptability of standard Transformers to dense prediction tasks, achieving strong performance in real-world scenarios.

articles.title_zh: PCT-Prompt:指向点云中密集预测任务的快速变换器框架
articles.content_zh: 标准变形器在点云对象分类上已证明是有效的,但它们在复杂场景中密集的预测任务中的性能经常被薄弱的前作假设所阻碍. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提议PCT-Prompt,这是一个通过引入一个即时制导的特性分支来增强标准变形器的新框架,以改善密集预测任务中的性能. 标准变形器分支为从点云数据提取出全球地物预加训练的模型提供杠杆作用,为处理高水平地物提供主干. 同时,即时导特征分会由两个关键部分组成: 一个精细分会特征取出块,利用几何敏感抽象层捕捉多尺度几何特征,与PnP-3D分会层结合局部环境与全球规范化. 第二个组成部分是即时精细的特征学习块产生即时符号,这些符号后来通过交叉注意机制来被精炼. 此外,我们引入了快速投放机制,逐步去除跨变形器层的快速信息,平衡局部细节和全球一致性. 有关ShapeNetPart,S3DIS,和DALES数据集的实验结果显示,PCT-Prompt显著地提高了标准变形器对密集预测任务的适应性,在现实世界情景中实现了强效.

articles.title: SingDance: Compositional Zero-Shot Singing-and-Dancing Video Generation with Role-Aware Audio Conditioning
articles.content: Generating personalized dance videos from a reference image, text prompt, and audio track requires music-conditioned body motion. Singing-and-dancing adds a second requirement: the visible subject must also articulate the vocals. Existing music-conditioned methods focus primarily on choreography, while speech-driven models generally assume that the visible subject produces the input voice, leaving this combined setting largely underexplored. We introduce SingDance, a unified video diffusion framework that formulates controllable vocal articulation as a semantic role: the visible subject is either the source, who produces the vocal signal, or the listener, who receives it from an off-screen performer. Hard-compact routing selects task-relevant speech, music, and role conditions, which are composed through frame-wise joint audio injection; source and listener retain the same speech pathway. Training uses asymmetric supervision: on-screen speaking and curated off-screen conversational-response videos establish role control, while instrumental and song-based dancing-only videos establish music-conditioned body motion. The target Song/Source configuration is never observed during training. At inference, assigning the source role to a song composes separately learned articulation and song-conditioned dance capabilities, enabling compositional zero-shot singing-and-dancing. Experiments demonstrate strong motion--beat alignment and visual fidelity, reliable paired switching of vocal articulation while preserving music-aligned body motion, and highly competitive lip synchronization with substantially fewer generation-time parameters than the strongest speech-driven baseline evaluated.
